His saying: ﴿لَقُضِيَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَجَلُهُمْ﴾ is also read: (لقَضَى إليهم أجلهم). Like it is ﴿فيمسك التى قَضَى عليها الموتَ﴾ and (قُضِى عليها الموتُ).

farraa:12-12.t: His saying: ﴿مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمْ يَدْعُنَآ إِلَىٰ ضُرٍّ مَّسَّهُ﴾: He says: he continued in his former way, before the affliction struck him.

farraa:16-16.t:
His saying: ﴿قُل لَّوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلاَ أَدْرَاكُمْ بِهِ﴾: it has been mentioned of al-Ḥasan that he said: "ولا أَدْرَأْتكم به". If there is a dialect form in it other than darītu and adraytu, perhaps al-Ḥasan inclined to it. But that it should be correct from darītu or adraytu — no; because yāʾ and wāw, when what precedes them has a fatḥa and they are quiescent, remain sound and do not change into alif, as in qaḍaytu and daʿawtu.
Perhaps al-Ḥasan followed his natural instinct and his eloquence and gave it a hamza, because it resembles daraʾtu al-ḥadd (I averted the legal punishment) and the like.
Sometimes the Arabs make mistakes in a word when another word with a hamza resembles it, and they put a hamza in what has none. I heard a woman of Ṭayyiʾ say: رنأْت زوجى بأبياتٍ ("I lamented my husband with verses"). They also say labbaʾtu bi-l-ḥajj and ḥallaʾtu al-sawīq, and they err; because ḥallaʾtu may be said of driving thirsty camels away [from water], and in labbaʾtu he went to al-libaʾ (beestings) which is eaten, and in rathaʾtu zawjī she went to rathīʾat al-laban (a mixture of milk), that is, when you milk fresh milk onto curdled milk.
[Translator's note: the woman's word is printed first «رنأت» and later «رثأت»; the latter (for رثيت, "I lamented") is evidently intended.]

farraa:21-21.t:
His saying: ﴿وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً مِّن بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُمْ إِذَا لَهُمْ مَّكْرٌ﴾: the Arabs make (إذا) do duty for "I did" and "they did". This place is of that kind: (إذا) sufficed in place of (فعلوا). Had it been said (مِن بعدِ ضراء مستهم مكروا), it would be correct.
It is common in speech and in the Qurʾān. We say: خرجت فإذا أنا بزيد ("I went out, and there I was with Zayd"). They do likewise with (إذْ), as in the poet's saying:
بينما هنَّ الأراك معا * إذا أتى راكب على جملِه
(While they were [among] the arāk trees together, lo, a rider came on his camel.)
Most speech in this position drops (إذ), so it is said:
بينا تَبَغِيِّهِ العَشَاء وطَوْفِه * وقع العَشاءُ به على سِرْحانِ
(While he was seeking his supper and roaming about, the supper led him onto a wolf.)
Their meaning is the same, with (إذ) and with its dropping.
[Translator's note: the first verse is printed with «إذا» although the author speaks of «إذ».]

farraa:22-22.t:
His saying: ﴿يُسَيِّرُكُمْ﴾ is the reading of the generality. It is mentioned of Zayd ibn Thābit [that he read] (ينشركم), and Abū Jaʿfar al-Madanī read it so. Each is correct, if Allah wills.
His saying: ﴿جَآءَتْهَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ﴾ means the ship (al-fulk); He said "came to it" (feminine), while earlier in the passage He said ﴿وجرين بِهِم﴾ and not وجَرَت; and each is correct. You say: النساء قد ذهبت and ذهبن ("the women have gone"). Al-fulk is feminine and masculine, and may be singular or plural.
In [Sūrat] Yā-Sīn He said ﴿فى الفلك المشحون﴾, making al-fulk masculine, and here He said جاءتها, making it feminine.
If you wish you take it here as singular, and if you wish as plural. If you wish, you take the hāʾ in (جاءتها) to refer to the wind, as if you said: "a tempestuous wind came upon the good wind". And Allah knows best what is right in it. The Arabs say ʿāṣif and ʿāṣifa; and aʿṣafat al-rīḥ and ʿaṣafat.
The form with alif is the dialect of Banū Asad. One of Banū Dabīr recited to me:
حتى إذا أعصفت ريح مزعزِعة * فيها قِطار ورعد صوته زجِل
(Until, when a shaking wind blew violently, with rain-showers in it and thunder whose voice was loud.)

farraa:23-23.t:
His saying: ﴿يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَا بَغْيُكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِكُمْ﴾: if you wish, you place the khabar (predicate) of البغى in His saying (على أنفسكم), and then you put (متاعَ الحياةِ الدينا) in the accusative, as in your saying: "as an enjoyment in the life of this world". The nominative is also proper here, as a new beginning, as He said ﴿لم يلبثوا إِلا ساعة من نهارٍ بلاغ﴾, that is: that is (بلاغ), and that is (متاع الحياةِ الدنيا). Or, if you wish, you place the khabar in المتاع; and that is the proper form of speech.
[Translator's note: «الدينا» in the source is a misprint for «الدنيا».]

farraa:26-26.t: His saying: ﴿لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُواْ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ﴾ is in the position of the nominative. It is said that al-ḥusnā is the good reward (al-ḥasana). (وزيادة): Muḥammad related to us: al-Farrāʾ related to us, saying: Abū al-Aḥwaṣ Sallām ibn Sulaym related to me from Abū Isḥāq al-Sabīʿī from a man from Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, may Allah have mercy on him, who said: "For those who do good is the best and more": looking at the Face of the Lord, Blessed and Exalted is He. It is also said: (للذين أحسنوا الحسنى) means a good reward like their good deeds, (وزيادة) the addition of multiplication, as in His saying ﴿فله عَشْرُ أَمثالها﴾.

farraa:27-27.t:
His saying: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ كَسَبُواْ ٱلسَّيِّئَاتِ جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا﴾: you put الجزاء in the nominative by implying (لهم), as if you said: "then for them is the recompense of an evil deed by its like"; as He said ﴿ففِدية مِن صِيامٍ﴾ and ﴿فصيام ثلاثةِ أيام فى الحج﴾, the meaning being: then upon him is a fast of three days, and upon him is a ransom. If you wish, you put الجزاء in the nominative by the bāʾ in His saying ﴿جَزَآءُ سَيِّئَةٍ بِمِثْلِهَا﴾ [i.e. with بمثلها as its khabar]; but the first is more pleasing to me.
His saying: ﴿كَأَنَّمَا أُغْشِيَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ قِطَعاً﴾ and (قطْعا). Al-qiṭaʿ is the reading of the generality.
In the codex of Ubayy it is (كأنما يَغْشَى وجوهَهم قِطْع من الليل مظلم), and this is a proof for whoever reads it light (qiṭʿan). If you wish you make المظلم [a ḥāl (circumstantial)] — you saying qiṭʿ, qiṭʿan of the night — and if you wish you make المظلم an adjective (naʿt) of القطع. When you say qiṭʿan, it is a portion of the night specifically.
Al-qiṭʿ is the darkness of the end of the night: ﴿فأَسِر بأهلك بقطع من الليل﴾.
[Translator's note: the clause «وإن شئت جعلت المظلم وأنت تقول قِطْع قطعا من الليل» appears to be defective in the source; the bracketed "ḥāl" is a conjecture from the contrast with the following clause.]

farraa:28-28.t:
His saying: ﴿فَزَيَّلْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ is not from zultu [zāla, yazūlu: to cease]; it is rather from ziltu dhā min dhā ("I separated this from that"), when you separate this from that.
He said (فزيَّلنا) because of the abundance of the action; had it been little, you would say: زِلْ ذا من ذا, as you say: مِزْ ذا من ذا ("distinguish this from that"). Some read (فزايلنا بينهم). That is like His saying (يراءون ويرءُّون) and (ولا تصعِّر، ولا تصاعر). The Arabs come close to equating fāʿaltu and faʿʿaltu in much of their speech, as long as they do not intend "you did to me and I did to you"; when they intend that, it can only be fāʿaltu. When you intend ʿāhadtuka, rāʾaytuka and anything in which the action is single, that is what admits faʿʿaltu and fāʿaltu. Likewise they say: kālamtu fulānan and kallamtuhu ("I spoke to so-and-so"); and "they had been estranged, and then began to speak to each other (yatakālamān and yatakallamān)".

farraa:30-30.t:
His saying: ﴿هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُواْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾: ʿAbdallāh ibn Masʿūd read it (تتلو), with tāʾ. Its meaning — and Allah knows best — is: tatlū, that is, every soul reads its deeds in a book; as in His saying: ﴿ونخرِج له يوم القِيامةِ كِتابا يلقاه منشورا﴾ and His saying ﴿فأما من أُوتِى كِتابه بِيمينِه﴾. And His saying ﴿اقرأ كِتابك﴾ strengthens the reading of ʿAbdallāh. Mujāhid read it (تبلو كل نفسٍ ما أسلفت), that is, it experiences it and sees it. Each is good. Muḥammad related to us: al-Farrāʾ related to me: Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-Taymī related to us from Mughīra from Mujāhid that he read (تبلو) with bāʾ. Al-Farrāʾ said: some of the shaykhs related to me from al-Kalbī from Abū Ṣāliḥ from Ibn ʿAbbās: (تبلو) means "experiences"; and so Ibn ʿAbbās read it.
His saying ﴿وَرُدُّوۤاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوْلاَهُمُ ٱلْحَقِّ﴾: (الحقِّ): you make it one of the attributes of Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He. If you wish, you make it accusative, meaning: they were returned to Allah truly; or if you wish: their Master truly.

farraa:32-32.t: Likewise His saying: ﴿فَذَلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ﴾ has in it what is in the first.

farraa:33-33.t:
His saying, the Exalted: ﴿كَذَلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ﴾: it is read (كلمة ربِك) and (كلمات ربك); the reading of the people of Medina is, as the preponderant view [has it, the plural].
His saying: ﴿عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوۤاْ أَنَّهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: it became due upon them because they do not believe, or in that they do not believe; so its position is accusative when you drop the genitive-governing particle [i.e. accusative by removal of the preposition]. Had you used the kasra and said "إنهم", it would be correct, as a new beginning. Likewise His saying ﴿آمنت أنه لا إِله إِلا الذِىِ آمنتْ بِه بنو إِسرائِيل﴾; the companions of ʿAbdallāh gave it a kasra, as a new beginning.
[Translator's note: «قراءة أهل المدينة على الراجح» is terse and possibly corrupt; the bracketed completion is conjectural.]

farraa:35-35.t: His saying: ﴿أَمَّن لاَّ يَهِدِّيۤ إِلاَّ أَن يُهْدَىٰ﴾: He says: you worship what is unable to move from its place unless it is moved and you carry it.

farraa:37-37.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنُ أَن يُفْتَرَىٰ﴾: the meaning — and Allah knows best — is: it was not fitting for the like of this Qurʾān to be forged. It has the meaning of: "this Qurʾān was not such as to be forged" (ما كان هذا القرآن لِيفترى). Like it is ﴿وما كان المؤمِنون لِينفِروا كافة﴾, that is: it was not fitting for them to go out all together; because they had [once] gone out all together, so the meaning indicates that it is not fitting for them to do so another time. Like it is ﴿وما كان لِنبىّ أن يَغُلّ﴾, that is: it is not fitting for a prophet to defraud, or to be defrauded. So (أَنْ) comes in the sense of "it is fitting"; as He said ﴿مالك أَلاَّ تَكُونَ مَعَ الساجِدين﴾, the meaning being "what prevented you"; so (أن) was brought in with (مالك) since its meaning is "what prevented you". What shows that their meaning is one is that He said to him in one place (ما منعك) and in another (مالك), and the story of Iblīs is one.

farraa:44-44.t:
His saying: ﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ ٱلنَّاسَ شَيْئاً وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ﴾: the Arabs have two usages for (لكن): with the nūn doubled and with it quiescent. Whoever doubles it puts nouns in the accusative with it, and neither faʿala nor yafʿalu [i.e. no verb] follows it directly. Whoever lightens its nūn and makes it quiescent does not make it govern anything, noun or verb; what governs the noun after it is what comes with it, putting it in the accusative, nominative or genitive. Of that is His saying ﴿ولكِنِ الناسُ أَنفسهم يظلِمون﴾, ﴿ولكِنِ اللّهُ رَمَى﴾, ﴿ولكِنِ الشياطينُ كفروا﴾: these words were put in the nominative by the verbs that come after them. As for His saying ﴿ما كان محمد أَبا أَحدٍ مِن رِجالِكم ولكِن رسولَ اللّهِ﴾, you imply (كان) after (لكن) and put [the noun] in the accusative by it; had you put it in the nominative by implying (هو) — "but he is the Messenger of Allah" — it would be correct. Like it is ﴿وما كان هذا القرآن أن يفترى مِن دونِ اللّهِ ولكِن تصدِيقَ الذى بين يديه﴾ and (تصدِيقُ); and like it is ﴿ما كان حدِيثا يفترى ولكِن تصدِيقَ الذى بين يديه﴾ and (وتصديقُ).
When you drop from (لكن) the wāw at its beginning, the Arabs prefer to lighten its nūn.
And when they bring in the wāw, they prefer to double it. They did that only because it is a retraction of what applied at the beginning of the speech, so it was likened to bal, since it is a retraction like it. Do you not see that you say: لم يقم أخوك بل أبوك ("your brother did not stand, but your father"), and then say: لم يقم أخوك لكن أبوك, and you see that the two have one meaning? Now the wāw is not proper with bal; so when they said (ولكن), bringing in the wāw, it moved away from (بل), since the wāw is not proper with (بل); so they preferred to double the nūn in it, and treated the wāw as though it were a wāw that came in for conjunction, not in the sense of bal.
The Arabs put [nouns] in the accusative with it when its nūn is doubled only because its origin is: إنّ عبدالله قائم ("ʿAbdallāh is standing"); a lām and a kāf were added to (إن) and the whole became a single particle. Do you not see that the poet said:
* ولكننِى مِن حُبّها لكَميد *
(But I, from my love for her, am indeed sorrowful.)
The lām [of emphasis] came in only because its meaning is inna.
As for what it was joined to at its beginning, it is like the saying of the poet:
لهِنَّكِ من عَبْسِيّةٍ لوِسيمةٌ * على هُنُواتٍ كاذبٍ من يقولها
(By Allah, you are, for a woman of ʿAbs, beautiful indeed, despite certain little things — a liar is whoever says them.)
Here he joined (إنّ) with a lām and a hāʾ, just as there it was joined with a lām and a kāf. A particle may be joined [with additions] at its beginning and at its end. What is joined at its beginning is (هذا), (ها ذاك): joined with (ها) at its beginning. Of what is joined at its end is His saying ﴿إمَّا تُرِيَنِّى ما يُوعدون﴾, and the saying لتذهبن and لتجلسن ("you shall surely go / sit"): joined at its end with nūn and with (ما). We think that the Arabs' saying كم مالك ("how much is your wealth?") is (ما) joined at its beginning with a kāf; then the use of (كم) became so frequent that the alif was dropped from its end and its mīm became quiescent, as they said: لِمْ قلت ذاك؟ ("why did you say that?"), meaning لِمَ قلت ذاك and لمَا قلت ذاك. The poet said:
يا أبا الأسود لِمْ أسلمتنى * لهموم طارقات وذِكر
(O Abū al-Aswad, why have you abandoned me to cares that come by night and to memories?)
One of the Arabs, when asked "منذ كم قعد فلان؟" ("Since how long has so-and-so been sitting?"), said in his speech: كَمُذْ أخذتَ فى حديثك ("as long as since you began your talk"); his bringing the kāf back to (مذ) shows that the kāf in (كم) is additional. They also say [in answer to] "How are you this morning?": كالخير and كخير ("as good / like good"). And one of them was asked: "How do you make aqiṭ (dried curd)?", and he said: كهيّن ("like something easy").
[Translator's note: «الأفافيل» in the source is a misprint for «الأفاعيل» ("the verbs").]

farraa:46-46.t:
His saying: ﴿فَإِلَيْنَا مَرْجِعُهُمْ ثُمَّ ٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: (ثم) here is a conjunction. And if it were said: ثَمَّ اللّهُ شهيد على ما يفعلون, it would mean: there Allah is witness over what they do.
[Translator's note: the source leaves the conditional "if it were said…" without its apodosis; "it would mean" is supplied.]

farraa:50-50.t: His saying: ﴿إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ عَذَابُهُ بَيَاتاً أَوْ نَهَاراً مَّاذَا يَسْتَعْجِلُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾: if you wish you make (ماذا) a pure question by way of wonder, as in saying: "Woe to them, what did they want by seeking to hasten the punishment?!" And if you wish, you magnify the matter of the punishment and say: "With what have they sought to hasten!" Its position is nominative if you make the hāʾ refer back to it; and if you make the hāʾ in (منه) refer to the punishment, and put it [ماذا] in the position of the accusative, you make the hastening fall on it.

farraa:51-51.t:
His saying: ﴿الآنَ وَقَدْ كُنتُم بِهِ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ﴾: (الآن) is a word built with the alif and lām, which have not been removed from it, and it was left in the manner of an adverb (ṣifa, i.e. ẓarf), because it is an adverb in meaning and in form; just as you have seen them do with (الذى) and (الذين), leaving them in the manner of a particle, with the alif and lām never separated from them. Like it the poet said:
فإن الألاءِ يعلمونك منهم * كعلمى مظَّنُّوك ما دمت أشعرا
(Those among them who know you as I know you will suspect you as long as you are hairy [i.e. a coward].)
He put the alif and lām on (ألاء) and then left it with kasra in the position of the accusative, as it was before the alif and lām were put on it. Like it is his saying:
وأنى حُبست اليوم والأمسِ قبله * ببابك حتى كادت الشمس تغرب
(And that I was held today, and yesterday before it, at your door, until the sun was about to set.)
He put the alif and lām on (أمس) and then left it with kasra in (its original manner). Like it is the saying of another:
تفقَّأُ فوقه القَلَع السوارى * وجُنَّ الخازبَازَ به جنونا
(The night-travelling clouds burst open above it, and the flies (al-khāzbāz) went mad in it.)
So (الآن) is like that in that it was accusative before the alif and lām were put on it; then they were put on it and did not change it. The origin of al-āna was (أوان) [awān]: the alif was dropped from it and its wāw changed into an alif, as they said riyāḥ for al-rāḥ (wine). Abū al-Qamqām al-Faqʿasī recited to me:
كأن مَكَاكِىَّ الجِواء غُدَيَّةً * نشاوَى تساقَوا بالرَيَاح المفَلْفَل
(As if the larks of the valley, early in the morning, were drunkards who had passed round to one another peppered wine.)
So he made riyāḥ and awān sometimes on the pattern of faʿal and sometimes on the pattern of faʿāl, as they say zaman and zamān.
Or, if you wish, you take the origin of (الآن) to be your saying āna laka an tafʿala ("it is time for you to do"); the alif and lām were put on it and then it was left in the manner of faʿala [the past verb], so the accusative came to it from the fatḥa of faʿala. That is a good explanation, as they said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade qīla and qāla and asking many questions"; they were like two nouns, yet they have fatḥa. Had they been put in the genitive, as having been taken out of the intention of a verb, it would be correct. I heard the Arabs say: من شُبَّ إلى دُبَّ with fatḥa, and من شُبٍّ إلى دُبٍّ, meaning: from when he was young until he crept along [with old age]; and it is faʿala.

farraa:54-54.t: His saying: ﴿وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُاْ ٱلْعَذَابَ﴾ means the chiefs of the idolaters; they concealed it from their lowly followers whom they had led astray. فأسرُّوها, that is: they hid it.

farraa:58-58.t:
His saying: ﴿قُلْ بِفَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَبِرَحْمَتِهِ فَبِذَلِكَ فَلْيَفْرَحُواْ﴾ is the reading of the generality. It is mentioned of Zayd ibn Thābit that he read (فبذلك فلتفرحوا), that is, O Companions of Muḥammad, with tāʾ.
His saying: ﴿هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ﴾: [what] the disbelievers gather. What strengthens the reading of Zayd is that in the reading of Ubayy it is (فبذلك فافرحوا). [The form with lām] is the form created for the command, whether you address [the person] directly or not; except that the Arabs dropped the lām from the verb of the directly addressed person being commanded, because of the frequency of the command in particular in their speech. They dropped the lām just as they dropped the tāʾ from the verb. You know that the jussive-governing and the accusative-governing particle fall only on the verb beginning with yāʾ, tāʾ, nūn or alif. So when the tāʾ was dropped, it took the lām away with it, and the alif was introduced in your saying iḍrib and ifraḥ; because the ḍād is quiescent, and it was not right to begin with a quiescent letter, so they brought in a light alif with which the beginning could be made, as He said: (ادّارَكوا) and (واثّاقَلْتُم). Al-Kisāʾī used to find fault with their saying (فلتفرحوا), because he found it rare and so made it a fault, whereas it is the original form. I have heard from the Prophet ﷺ that he said at one of the battles: (لتأخذوا مصافّكم) ("take your ranks"), meaning by it: خذوا مصافّكم.

farraa:61-61.t:
His saying: ﴿وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَمَا تَتْلُواْ مِنْهُ مِن قُرْآنٍ وَلاَ تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلاَّ كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُوداً﴾: He says: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, is witness over everything. (وما) here is negation and has no grammatical position.
It is like His saying ﴿ما يكون مِن نَّجْوَى ثَلاَثَةٍ إِلا هُوَ رابِعهم﴾; He says: except that He is their witness.
﴿وَمَا يَعْزُبُ عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلاَ أَصْغَرَ مِن ذٰلِكَ وَلاۤ أَكْبَرَ﴾, and (أصغرُ وأكبرُ). Whoever puts them with fatḥa only intends the genitive, making them follow المثقال or الذرّة. Whoever puts them in the nominative makes them follow the meaning of المثقال, because if you dropped (مِن) from المثقال it would be nominative. It is like your saying: ما أتانى من أحد عاقلٍ and عاقلٌ ("no intelligent person came to me"). Likewise His saying ﴿ما لكم مِن إِلهٍ غيرِه﴾.

farraa:62-63.t:
His saying: ﴿أَلاۤ إِنَّ أَوْلِيَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ...(62)ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾: (الذين) is in the position of the nominative, because it is an adjective (naʿt) that comes after the khabar (predicate) of inna; as He said ﴿إِن ذلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تخاصُمُ أَهْلِ النارِ﴾ and as He said ﴿قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِالحَقِّ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ﴾. The accusative in all of that is permissible, by following the first noun, and by repetition of (إنّ).
The Arabs put adjectives in the nominative when they come after the verbs in [a sentence with] (إنّ) only because they saw the verb in the nominative, and so imagined that its subject was nominative in meaning — since they did not find in the inflection of the accusative a noun in the accusative whose verb is in the nominative — so they put the adjective in the nominative. Al-Kisāʾī used to say: "I made it" — meaning the adjective — "follow the pronoun latent (muḍmar) in the verb." That is an error and is not permissible, because (الظريف) and its like are overt nouns, and an overt noun cannot be an adjective of a pronoun, except for such words as nafsuhu, anfusuhum, ajmaʿīn and kulluhum, because these only come as appendages at the ends of sentences; one does not say مررت بأجمعين ("I passed by all"), as one says مررت بالظريف ("I passed by the elegant one"). If you wish, you make His saying ﴿ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَكَانُواْ يَتَّقُونَ﴾ nominative
by His saying: ﴿لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِي ٱلْحَياةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا﴾ [i.e. as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is that clause].

farraa:64-64.t:
His saying: ﴿لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ فِي ٱلْحَياةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا﴾: it is mentioned that the glad tidings in the life of this world are the good dream which a Muslim sees or which is seen for him, and in the Hereafter Paradise. His saying ﴿لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ﴾ may also be what He has given them glad tidings of in His Book of what He has promised, as He said ﴿ويبشِر المؤمِنِين الذِين يعملون الصالِحاتِ﴾ in many places of the Qurʾān.
Then He said to them: ﴿لاَ تَبْدِيلَ لِكَلِمَاتِ ٱللَّهِ﴾, that is: there is no breaking of Allah's promise.

farraa:65-65.t:
His saying: ﴿وَلاَ يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّ ٱلْعِزَّةَ للَّهِ﴾: the meaning is a new beginning (istiʾnāf); they did not say that themselves, so that it would be a quotation (ḥikāya). As for His saying ﴿وقولهم إِنا قتلنا المسِيح﴾, it has a kasra because it comes after "saying"; whatever (إن) comes after "saying" has a kasra, as quotation, after qāla, yaqūlūna and whatever is inflected from qawl. As for His saying ﴿ما قلت لهم إلاَّ ما أَمرْتَنِى بِهِ أَن اعبُدُوا اللّهَ ربِّى﴾, you give (أن) a fatḥa because it explains (ما), and the saying has fallen on (ما) and made it accusative, so its position is accusative. Like it in speech: قد قلت لك كلاما حسنا: أن أباك شريف وأَنك عاقل ("I have said good words to you: that your father is noble and that you are intelligent"): you give (أَنّ) a fatḥa because it explains الكلام, and الكلام is accusative. Had you intended to repeat the saying over it, you would give it a kasra. (أنّ) may also have a fatḥa after "saying" when the saying puts it in the nominative or it puts the saying in the nominative; of that is your saying: قولُك مذ اليوم أَن الناس خارجون ("your saying since today is that the people are going out"), as you say: قولك مذ اليوم كلام لا يفهم ("your saying since today is speech that is not understood").
His saying ﴿ولا تقولن لِشىءٍ إنى فاعِل ذلِك غدا إلا أَن يشاء الله﴾: the meaning is: do not say of anything "I shall do that tomorrow" except with the exception, that is, except that you say "if Allah wills". Had you meant: "do not say of anything 'I shall do that'; do not say [anything] except 'if Allah wills'", it would be as if he were commanded to say "if Allah wills" by itself; so the أن with fatḥa is indispensable for the exception specifically. Do you not see that you may command him when he swears an oath and say: "Say: if Allah wills (إن شاء الله)"? So when the word by itself is meant, it can only be with kasra.
[Translator's note: «إذا خلف» in the source is probably «إذا حلف» ("when he swears an oath"); translated in that sense.]

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الر﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿تلك آيات الكتاب الحكيم﴾: «تلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «آيات الكتاب» is the khabar (predicate), and «الحكيم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿الكتاب﴾».

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿أكان للناس عجبا أن أوحينا إلى رجل منهم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval mixed with wonder, «كان» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, «للناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it has come before the adjective [it would otherwise qualify]; «عجبًا» is the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان», «﴿أن﴾» is maṣdariyya, «﴿أوحينا﴾» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), the interpreted maṣdar formed from «﴿أن أوحينا﴾» is the noun of «كان», «﴿إلى رجل﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أوحينا﴾», and «﴿منهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «رجل».
﴿أن أنذر الناس﴾: «﴿أن﴾» is explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation carries the meaning of saying without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or «﴿أن﴾» is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to «﴿أوحى﴾», and the clause «﴿أنذر﴾» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «﴿أن﴾», with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source writes «أوحى»; the verb in the ayah is «أوحينا».] «أنذر» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» ("you"), and «الناس» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وبشر الذين آمنوا أن لهم قدم صدق عند ربهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «بشر» is conjoined to «أنذر», «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi, the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position; «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and «﴿أن﴾» together with what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن»; «﴿لهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar, «قدم صدق» is its postponed noun, and the adverb «عند ربهم» is attached to an omitted adjective of «﴿قدم صدق﴾».
﴿قال الكافرون إن هذا لساحر مبين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «﴿قال الكافرون﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil, «إن» is an abrogating particle, «هذا» is its noun, «ساحر» is its khabar, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «مبين» is an adjective of «ساحر», and the clause is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿إن ربكم الله الذي خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «ربكم» is its noun, the Name of Majesty is its khabar (predicate), «الذي» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿الله﴾», the clause «خلق السماوات والأرض» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position, and «﴿في ستة أيام﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿خلق﴾».
﴿ثم استوى على العرش يدبر الأمر﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), «استوى» is conjoined to «خلق», «على العرش» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿استوى﴾», and the clause «يدبر الأمر» is a second khabar of «﴿إن﴾», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ما من شفيع إلا من بعد إذنه﴾: «﴿ما﴾» is negative, without governing effect, «﴿من﴾» is a connective (ṣila) preposition, «﴿شفيع﴾» is genitive in form and nominative by position, as a mubtadaʾ (subject); «﴿إلا﴾» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «﴿من بعد﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar, «﴿إذنه﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ذلكم الله ربكم فاعبدوه أفلا تذكرون﴾: «ذلكم» is a mubtadaʾ, «﴿الله﴾» is a badal (substitute), «﴿ربكم﴾» is the khabar of «﴿ذلكم﴾», the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference), «اعبدوه» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted, «لا» is negative, and «تذكرون» is an imperfect verb whose original form is «تتذكرون».

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إليه مرجعكم جميعا﴾: «﴿إليه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مرجعكم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «جميعًا» is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وعد الله حقا﴾: «﴿وعد﴾» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «﴿حقًّا﴾» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause, the implied form being «حق ذلك حقا» ("that is true, truly").
﴿إنه يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده﴾: «إن» and its noun; the clause «يبدأ» is its khabar, «الخلق» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «ثم يعيده» is conjoined to «يبدأ الخلق», and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ليجزي الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات بالقسط﴾: the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «يجزي» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «﴿يعيده﴾»; «الذين» is the object of «يجزي», the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «عملوا الصالحات» is conjoined to «آمنوا», and «بالقسط» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يجزي», i.e. because of their equity and justice; or [it is] a ḥāl, either from the fāʿil (agent) or from the object, i.e. He rewards them while being characterised by equity, i.e. just, or [they] being characterised by it.
﴿والذين كفروا لهم شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم بما كانوا يكفرون﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «﴿لهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, «شراب» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, «﴿من حميم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «شراب», «عذاب» is conjoined to «شراب», the clause «﴿لهم شراب﴾» is the khabar of «الذين», and «أليم» is an adjective of «عذاب»; in «﴿بما﴾» the bāʾ is a causal preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya, «﴿كانوا﴾» is «كان» and its noun, the clause «يكفرون» is its khabar, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from «ما» and the verb after it is genitive by the bāʾ, i.e. «بكفرهم» ("because of their disbelief"); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted second adjective of «﴿عذاب﴾», or attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «ذلك بسبب كفرهم» ("that is because of their disbelief").

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿هو الذي جعل الشمس ضياء والقمر نورا﴾: «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الذي» is its khabar (predicate), and the clause «جعل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position; if «جعل» means "to make into" (taṣyīr), «الشمس» is the first object and «ضياء» the second object; if «جعل» means "to create", «الشمس» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and «ضياء» a ḥāl (circumstantial); and «﴿القمر نورًا﴾» is conjoined to the two of them.
﴿وقدره منازل لتعلموا عدد السنين والحساب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «قدره» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi; «منازل» means «في منازل» ("in stations"), so it is accusative as an adverb (ẓarfiyya); or the implied form is «ذا منازل» ("possessing stations"), and on this view «﴿قدّر﴾» is transitive to two objects, because its meaning is "to make, to render", so it [«منازل»] is a second object; or «قدر» is transitive to one [object] in the sense of "to create", that [object] being the hāʾ, and «منازل» is a ḥāl, i.e. moving [from station to station]. It has also been said: the pronoun is accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition having been omitted, i.e. «قدر له منازل» ("He determined for it stations"), and «منازل» is a mafʿūl bihi. The lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «تعلموا» is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿قدره﴾»; «عدد» is a mafʿūl bihi, «السنين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الحساب» is conjoined to «عدد».
﴿ما خلق الله ذلك إلا بالحق يفصل الآيات لقوم يعلمون﴾: «ما» is negative, «﴿خلق الله ذلك﴾» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «بالحق» is a ḥāl, the exception being emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of circumstances, i.e. He did not create that except as accompanied by truth and consummate wisdom, and He did not create it in vain; the clause «﴿يفصل الآيات﴾» is also a ḥāl, «الآيات» is a mafʿūl bihi, «﴿لقوم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يفصل﴾», and the clause «يعلمون» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿قوم﴾».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿إن في اختلاف الليل والنهار وما خلق الله في السماوات والأرض لآيات لقوم يتقون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «﴿في اختلاف﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «﴿إن﴾», «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun conjoined to «اختلاف», or «﴿ما﴾» is maṣdariyya and the maṣdar is conjoined to «اختلاف»; «﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خلق»; in «﴿لآيات﴾» the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and «آيات» is the postponed noun of «إن»; «﴿لقوم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «آيات», and the clause «يتقون» is an adjective of «قوم».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إن الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «الذين» is its noun, the clause «لا يرجون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, and «لقاءنا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ورضوا بالحياة الدنيا واطمأنوا بها﴾: conjoined to «﴿لا يرجون لقاءنا﴾», so it falls under the ruling of the ṣila; or the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), with «قد» implied; and the same is said of «﴿واطمأنوا بها﴾».
﴿والذين هم عن آياتنا غافلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «الذين» is conjoined to the preceding «﴿الذين﴾», «﴿هم﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «عن آياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿غافلون﴾», «غافلون» is the khabar (predicate) of «﴿هم﴾», and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿أولئك مأواهم النار بما كانوا يكسبون﴾: «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «مأواهم» is a second mubtadaʾ, «النار» is the khabar (predicate) of the second, the second together with its khabar is the khabar of «أولئك», and «أولئك» together with its khabar is the khabar of «إن»; in «﴿بما﴾» the bāʾ is a causal preposition and «ما» is maṣdariyya, «﴿كانوا﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and the clause «يكسبون» is its khabar, i.e. because of their earning; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «ذلك بسبب كسبهم» ("that is because of their earning").

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات يهديهم ربهم بإيمانهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «الذين» is its noun, the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «عملوا» is conjoined to «آمنوا», «الصالحات» is an object, and the clause «يهديهم ربهم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿تجري من تحتهم الأنهار في جنات النعيم﴾: the clause is a second khabar of «﴿إن﴾», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «يهديهم», or resumptive with no grammatical position; «﴿في جنات النعيم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted third khabar, or a second ḥāl, or attached to «﴿تجري﴾».

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿دعواهم فيها سبحانك اللهم وتحيتهم فيها سلام﴾: «دعواهم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿فيها﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دعواهم», or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «سبحانك» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause composed of it is the khabar (predicate) of «دعواهم»; «﴿اللهم﴾» is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, the doubled mīm being a substitute for the vocative particle; «تحيتهم» is a mubtadaʾ, «﴿فيها﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تحيتهم﴾», or to an omitted ḥāl, and «سلام» is the khabar of «تحيتهم»; the maṣdar, meaning «التحية» ("the greeting"), is annexed to its object, the agent being latent (mustatir), i.e. Allah's greeting to them, or the angels' greeting to them; or it is annexed to its agent, i.e. and they greet one another.
﴿وآخر دعواهم أن الحمد لله رب العالمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «آخر» is a mubtadaʾ, «دعواهم» is muḍāf ilayhi, «أن» is lightened from the heavy [«أنّ»], its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); «الحمد» is a mubtadaʾ, «﴿لله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar, «رب العالمين» is an adjective (ṣifa), or a badal (substitute) from «﴿الله﴾», and the clause «﴿الحمد لله...﴾» is the khabar of the lightened «أن». [Translator's note: the source does not state what the khabar of «آخر» is; on its analysis this is «أن» with its clause.]

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿ولو يعجل الله للناس الشر استعجالهم بالخير لقضي إليهم أجلهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «﴿لو﴾» is a conditional particle of impossibility (imtināʿ), «﴿يعجل﴾» is an imperfect verb, «﴿الله﴾», the Name of Majesty, is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; «﴿للناس﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يعجل﴾», «﴿الشر﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «﴿استعجالهم﴾» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being «تعجيلا مثل استعجالهم» ("a hastening like their seeking to hasten"); the maṣdar and its annexed adjective were omitted and the muḍāf ilayhi was put in its place; «﴿بالخير﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar, which is «استعجالهم»; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو», «﴿قضى﴾» is a past verb in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), «﴿إليهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿قضي﴾», and «﴿أجلهم﴾» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فنذر الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا في طغيانهم يعمهون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «نذر» is conjoined to the implied sense of the negation, because «﴿لو يعجل﴾» contains the meaning of negating the hastening, as though it were said: "And We do not hasten evil for them, and their term is not decreed for them, so We leave…"; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن» ("We"), «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi, the clause «لا يرجون لقاءنا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «في طغيانهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يعمهون﴾», and the clause «يعمهون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وإذا مس الإنسان الضر﴾: the wāw is resumptive, «إذا» is an adverb for future time, the clause «مس» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it, «الإنسان» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «الضر» is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿دعانا لجنبه أو قاعدا أو قائما﴾: the clause «دعانا» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of «﴿إذا﴾»; «لجنبه» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «﴿دعانا﴾», as shown by the two following ḥāls conjoined to it; «﴿أو﴾» is a conjunction, «قاعدًا» is conjoined to the position of «لجنبه», and likewise «أو قائمًا»; the clause «﴿وإذا مس الإنسان...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فلما كشفنا عنه ضره مر كأن لم يدعنا إلى ضر مسه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa), «كشفنا» is a verb and its fāʿil, «عنه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿كشفنا﴾», the clause «مر» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of «﴿لما﴾»; «﴿كأن﴾» is lightened from the heavy [«كأنّ»], its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the clause «لم يدعنا» is its khabar (predicate), «﴿إلى ضر﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يدعنا﴾», and the clause «مسه» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿ضر﴾».
﴿كذلك زين للمسرفين ما كانوا يعملون﴾: in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. «تزيينًا مثلَ ذلك زُيِّن للمسرفين عملُهم» ("with an adorning like that, their deeds were made to seem fair to the transgressors"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «﴿زين﴾» is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, built for that whose agent is not named (passive), «﴿للمسرفين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿زين﴾», «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); in «﴿كانوا﴾», «كان» is an abrogating verb (kāna and its sisters) and the wāw of the plural is the noun of «كان», the clause «﴿يعملون﴾» is the khabar of «كان», and the clause «﴿كانوا يعملون﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ولقد أهلكنا القرون من قبلكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «أهلكنا القرون» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object, and «من قبلكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أهلكنا».
﴿لما ظلموا وجاءتهم رسلهم بالبينات﴾: «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), attached to «﴿أهلكنا﴾», or linking (rābiṭa); «ظلموا» is a verb and its fāʿil; in «﴿وجاءتهم﴾» the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), with «قد» implied, and it has been said that the wāw is for conjunction to «ظلموا»; «﴿جاءتهم رسلهم﴾» is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil, and «بالبينات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جاءتهم»; the clause «﴿ولقد أهلكنا القرون...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما كانوا ليؤمنوا كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين﴾: conjoined to «﴿ظلموا﴾»; the lām in «﴿ليؤمنوا﴾» is for denial (juḥūd), «يؤمنوا» is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «﴿أن﴾», the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كانوا»; in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being «جزاءً مثلَ ذلك نجزي» ("with a recompense like that We recompense"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «﴿نجزي﴾» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن» ("We"), «﴿القوم﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, and «﴿المجرمين﴾» is an adjective of «القوم».

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ثم جعلناكم خلائف في الأرض من بعدهم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction, «جعلناكم» is conjoined to «أهلكنا», «خلائف» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «﴿في الأرض﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «خلائف», and «﴿من بعدهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿جعلناكم﴾».
﴿لننظر كيف تعملون﴾: the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «ننظر» is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after it, the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «جعلناكم»; «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi of «﴿تعملون﴾», or «كيف» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. in what state you will do the deeds befitting succession [in the land].

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «إذا» is an adverb of future time that includes the meaning of condition, the clause «تتلى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) to it; «تتلى» is an imperfect verb in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تتلى﴾», «آياتنا» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿قال الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا ائت بقرآن غير هذا أو بدله﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of «﴿إذا﴾»; «الذين» is the fāʿil (agent), the clause «لا يرجون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «لقاءنا» is the object of «يرجون», the clause «ائت» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl), «بقرآن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿ائت﴾», «﴿غير﴾» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿قرآن﴾», «﴿هذا﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi, «﴿أو﴾» is a conjunction, and «﴿بدله﴾» is conjoined to «﴿ائت﴾».
﴿قل ما يكون لي أن أبدله من تلقاء نفسي﴾: «ما» is negative, «﴿يكون﴾» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, «﴿لي﴾» is its fronted khabar (predicate), and «﴿أن﴾» together with what falls within its scope is its postponed noun; or «﴿يكون﴾» is complete (tāmma) and the maṣdar is the fāʿil; «﴿من تلقاء نفسي﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أبدله﴾», and «﴿نفسي﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي﴾: «إن» is negative, «أتبع» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنا» ("I"), «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «﴿ما﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «﴿يوحى إلي﴾» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.
﴿إني أخاف إن عصيت ربي عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, the clause «أخاف» is its khabar; «إن» is conditional, «عصيت» is a past verb in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is the fāʿil, «﴿ربي﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, «عذاب» is a mafʿūl bihi of «﴿أخاف﴾», «﴿يوم﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi, and «عظيم» is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿قل لو شاء الله ما تلوته عليكم ولا أدراكم به﴾: «﴿لو﴾» is conditional, «﴿شاء الله﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the clause «﴿ما تلوته عليكم﴾» is the apodosis (jawāb) of «﴿لو﴾», «﴿عليكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تلوته﴾»; in «﴿ولا﴾» the wāw is a conjunction and «﴿لا﴾» is negative; «﴿أدراكم﴾» is a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «﴿به﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أدراكم﴾».
﴿فقد لبثت فيكم عمرا من قبله أفلا تعقلون﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), «﴿قد﴾» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «﴿لبثت﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil, «﴿فيكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), «﴿عمرًا﴾» is an adverb of time attached to «﴿لبثت﴾», and «﴿من قبله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿لبثت﴾»; in «﴿أفلا﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied, «﴿لا﴾» is negative, and «﴿تعقلون﴾» is conjoined to the implied [verb].

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فمن أظلم ممن افترى على الله كذبا أو كذب بآياته﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «﴿من﴾» is an interrogative noun used for negation, a mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿أظلم﴾» is its khabar (predicate), «﴿ممن﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿أظلم﴾», the clause «﴿افترى﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, «﴿على الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿افترى﴾», and «﴿كذبا﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb «افترى», i.e. he invented a lie and fabricated it; or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. he fabricated for the sake of lying; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. he fabricated while being a liar, and it is an emphatic ḥāl. «﴿أو﴾» is a conjunction, «﴿كذب﴾» is conjoined to «﴿افترى﴾», and «﴿بآياته﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿كذب﴾».
﴿إنه لا يفلح المجرمون﴾: the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya); «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, the clause «﴿لا يفلح﴾» is its khabar, and «﴿المجرمون﴾» is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ويعبدون من دون الله ما لا يضرهم ولا ينفعهم﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «﴿يعبدون﴾» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), «﴿من دون الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «﴿يعبدون﴾», i.e. passing over Allah; «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the clause «﴿لا يضرهم﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and «﴿لا ينفعهم﴾» is conjoined; it has also been said that «﴿ما﴾» is qualified (mawṣūfa, an indefinite qualified by what follows).
﴿ويقولون هؤلاء شفعاؤنا عند الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿يقولون﴾» is conjoined to «﴿يعبدون﴾», «﴿هؤلاء﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿شفعاؤنا﴾» is the khabar (predicate), and «﴿عند الله﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿قل أتنبئون الله بما لا يعلم في السماوات ولا في الأرض﴾: «﴿قل﴾» is an imperative verb, the clause «﴿أتنبئون﴾» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl); in «﴿بما﴾» the bāʾ is a preposition and «﴿ما﴾» is relative, or a qualified indefinite; on both analyses the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «يعلمه» ("He knows it"); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «﴿تنبئون﴾», «﴿في السماوات﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the omitted returning pronoun in «﴿يعلم﴾», and the clause «﴿لا يعلم﴾» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.
﴿سبحانه وتعالى عما يشركون﴾: «﴿سبحانه﴾» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «﴿تعالى﴾» is a past verb, «﴿عما يشركون﴾» is attached to «﴿تعالى﴾», and «﴿ما﴾» is relative or maṣdariyya.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وما كان الناس إلا أمة واحدة فاختلفوا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «﴿ما﴾» is negative; in «﴿كان الناس﴾», «كان» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters) and «الناس» is its noun; «﴿إلا﴾» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «﴿أمة﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and «﴿واحدة﴾» is an adjective (ṣifa); «﴿فاختلفوا﴾» is conjoined according to the meaning, i.e. the people were all upon the truth, then they differed.
﴿ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لقضي بينهم فيما فيه يختلفون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿لولا﴾» is a particle of non-occurrence due to the existence [of something else], «﴿كلمة﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, the clause «﴿سبقت﴾» is an adjective of «﴿كلمة﴾», «﴿من ربك﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿سبقت﴾»; in «﴿لقضي﴾» the lām is [in] the apodosis (jawāb) of «لولا», and the clause «﴿قضي﴾» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «الأمر» ("the matter"); «﴿بينهم﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «﴿قضي﴾», «﴿فيما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to «﴿قضي﴾», «﴿فيه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يختلفون﴾», and the clause «﴿يختلفون﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ويقولون لولا أنزل عليه آية من ربه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿يقولون﴾» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿لولا﴾» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), «﴿أنزل﴾» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), «﴿عليه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿أنزل﴾», «﴿آية﴾» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «﴿من ربه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿آية﴾».
﴿فقل إنما الغيب لله فانتظروا إني معكم من المنتظرين﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the answer to «﴿لولا﴾», «﴿إنما﴾» is [«إنّ»] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), «﴿الغيب﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «﴿لله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); in «﴿فانتظروا﴾» the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference) and «﴿انتظروا﴾» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; in «﴿إني﴾», «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the yāʾ is its noun; «﴿من المنتظرين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar, and «﴿معكم﴾» is an adverb attached to «﴿المنتظرين﴾».

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وإذا أذقنا الناس رحمة من بعد ضراء مستهم إذا لهم مكر في آياتنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «﴿إذا﴾» is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis; the clause «﴿أذقنا﴾» is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; «﴿أذقنا﴾» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿الناس﴾» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «﴿رحمة﴾» is the second mafʿūl bihi, «﴿من بعد﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿رحمة﴾», «﴿ضراء﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause «﴿مستهم﴾» is an adjective of «﴿ضراء﴾»; «﴿إذا﴾» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), «﴿لهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «﴿مكر﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿في آياتنا﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «﴿مكر﴾», and the clause «﴿إذا لهم مكر﴾» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position.
﴿قل الله أسرع مكرا﴾: «﴿الله﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, «﴿أسرع﴾» is the khabar, and «﴿مكرًا﴾» is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿إن رسلنا يكتبون ما تمكرون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «رسلنا» is its noun, the clause «﴿يكتبون﴾» is its khabar, «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «﴿تمكرون﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿هو الذي يسيركم في البر والبحر﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الذي» is its khabar (predicate), the clause «يسيركم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position, the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «﴿في البر والبحر﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يسيركم﴾».
﴿حتى إذا كنتم في الفلك وجرين بهم بريح طيبة وفرحوا بها﴾: «حتى» is a particle of extent (ghāya) and of the genitive, «إذا» is an adverb for future time, the clause «﴿كنتم﴾» is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it, the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», and «في الفلك» is its khabar; «﴿جرين﴾» is conjoined, the nūn [of the feminine plural] for women being the fāʿil (agent) of «﴿جرين﴾», «﴿بهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جرين», «بريح طيبة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. «مسوقين» ("being driven"), «طيبة» is an adjective (ṣifa), and «فرحوا بها» is conjoined to «﴿وجرين﴾», or is a ḥāl clause from the pronoun of «﴿بهم﴾», with «﴿قد﴾» implied.
﴿جاءتها ريح عاصف وجاءهم الموج من كل مكان﴾: the clause «جاءتها» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of «إذا»; «ريح» is the fāʿil of «جاءتها», «عاصف» is an adjective, «جاءهم الموج» is conjoined to «جاءتها», and «﴿من كل مكان﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿جاءهم﴾», or to an omitted ḥāl from «الموج», i.e. «منحدرًا» ("descending").
﴿وظنوا أنهم أحيط بهم﴾: conjoined to «جاءهم»; «أن» together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of «ظنوا», and the clause «أحيط بهم» is the khabar of «﴿أنهم﴾».
﴿دعوا الله مخلصين له الدين﴾: the clause «﴿دعوا الله﴾» is a badal (substitute) from «﴿ظنوا﴾», a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl), or it is resumptive, built on a question that occurs to the mind, namely: "So what did they do?" — and it was said: "They called upon Allah"; on this view it has no grammatical position. «﴿دعوا الله﴾» is a verb, its fāʿil and its object, «مخلصين» is a ḥāl, «﴿له﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿مخلصين﴾», and «الدين» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لئن أنجيتنا من هذه لنكونن من الشاكرين﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), «إن» is conditional, «أنجيتنا» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «﴿من هذه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أنجيتنا﴾»; «لنكونن» is its answer [i.e. the answer of the oath], and the apodosis of the condition is omitted because the oath precedes; the oath and its answer are in the position of an accusative by an implied verb of saying, and that implied saying is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, the implied form being: «دعو الله قائلين: لئن أنجيتنا من هذه الأهوال لنكونن من الشاكرين» ("they called upon Allah, saying: if You save us from these terrors, we shall surely be among the grateful"). [Translator's note: the source writes «دعو» for «دعوا».]

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿فلما أنجاهم إذا هم يبغون في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa), «أنجاهم» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya), «هم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يبغون» is the khabar (predicate) of «﴿هم﴾», «﴿في الأرض﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يبغون﴾», and «﴿بغير الحق﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يا أيها الناس إنما بغيكم على أنفسكم﴾: «إنما» is [«إنّ»] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), «بغيكم» is a mubtadaʾ, and «﴿على أنفسكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
﴿متاع﴾: accusative as an adverb of time, i.e. «زمن متاع الحياة» ("the time of the enjoyment of life"); or accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in the place of a ḥāl, i.e. «متمتعين» ("enjoying"); or accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «يتمتعون متاع الحياة» ("they enjoy the enjoyment of life"); or accusative as a mafʿūl bihi of an implied verb indicated by the maṣdar, i.e. «يبغون متاع الحياة» ("they seek the enjoyment of life"); or accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. «لأجل متاع الحياة الدنيا» ("for the sake of the enjoyment of the life of this world").
﴿الحياة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).
﴿الدنيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «﴿الحياة﴾», genitive.
﴿ثم إلينا مرجعكم فننبئكم بما كنتم تعملون﴾: «﴿ثم﴾» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), «﴿إلينا﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, «مرجعكم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ; in «فننبئكم» the fāʾ is a conjunction and «ننبئكم» is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; «﴿بما كنتم تعملون﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿ننبئكم﴾», the clause «كنتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and the clause «تعملون» is the khabar of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿إنما مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء أنزلناه من السماء﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إنما» is [«إنّ»] restrained by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), «مثل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الحياة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «الدنيا» is an adjective (ṣifa); in «﴿كماء﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مِثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, «ماء» is muḍāf ilayhi, the clause «أنزلناه» is an adjective of «ماء», and «من السماء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿أنزلناه﴾».
﴿فاختلط به نبات الأرض مما يأكل الناس والأنعام﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «اختلط» is conjoined to «أنزلناه», «﴿به﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «اختلط», «نبات الأرض» is the fāʿil (agent) of «اختلط», «﴿مما يأكل الناس﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نبات الأرض», the clause «يأكل الناس» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and «الأنعام» is conjoined to «الناس».
﴿حتى إذا أخذت الأرض زخرفها وازينت﴾: «حتى» is a particle of extent (ghāya), «إذا» is an adverb for future time, attached to the apodosis (jawāb), which is «أتاها»; the clause «أخذت» is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it, «الأرض» is the fāʿil, «زخرفها» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ازينت» is conjoined to «أخذت».
﴿وظن أهلها أنهم قادرون عليها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ظن» is likewise conjoined, «أهلها» is the fāʿil of «ظن», «أن» together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of «ظن», «قادرون» is the khabar of «أن», and «عليها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿قادرون﴾».
﴿أتاها أمرنا ليلا أو نهارا﴾: «أتاها» is the apodosis of «إذا», «﴿ها﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, «أمرنا» is the fāʿil, «ليلا» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «أتاها», «﴿أو﴾» is a conjunction, and «نهارًا» is conjoined to «﴿ليلا﴾».
﴿فجعلناها حصيدا كأن لم تغن بالأمس﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «جعلناها» is a verb, its fāʿil and a first mafʿūl bihi, «حصيدًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi, «كأن» is lightened from the heavy [«كأنّ»], its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), the clause «لم تغن» is its khabar, and «بالأمس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تغن﴾».
﴿كذلك نفصل الآيات لقوم يتفكرون﴾: in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being «تفصيلا مثلَ ذلك نفصل الآيات» ("with an exposition like that We expound the signs"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «﴿نفصل﴾» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being «نحن» ("We"), «﴿الآيات﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, «﴿لقوم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿نفصل﴾», and the clause «يتفكرون» is an adjective of «﴿قوم﴾».

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿وقال موسى ربنا إنك آتيت فرعون وملأه زينة وأموالا في الحياة الدنيا﴾: قال موسى is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ربنا is a muḍāf munādā (the one addressed, vocative) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; إنّ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause آتيت is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; فرعون is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ملأه is conjoined to فرعون; زينة is the second mafʿūl bihi; أموالًا is conjoined to زينة; and ﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached (mutaʿalliq) to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of زينة.
﴿ربنا ليضلوا عن سبيلك﴾: ربنا is a muḍāf vocative; the lām is the lām of outcome and consequence (lām al-ṣayrūra wa-l-ʿāqiba), i.e. You gave them the blessings mentioned so that they would be grateful for them and follow Your way, but the outcome of their affair was that they were ungrateful for them and strayed from Your way; or the lām is the lām of cause (lām al-ʿilla), the meaning being: You gave them what You gave them in order to lead them on step by step (li-tastadrijahum). It has also been said: the lām is for invoking against them, that they remain in the misguidance they are in. عن سبيلك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضلوا﴾.
﴿ربنا اطمس على أموالهم واشدد على قلوبهم﴾: اطمس is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), and its agent is "you" (أنت); على قلوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اطمس [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase attached to اطمس is presumably على أموالهم, while على قلوبهم belongs to اشدد]; and ﴿واشدد على قلوبهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اطمس على أموالهم﴾.
﴿فلا يؤمنوا حتى يروا العذاب الأليم﴾: يؤمنوا is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the conjunctive fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding supplication, its implied form being: ﴿ليكن منك شد على قلوبهم فعدم إيمان منهم﴾ [Translator's note: this is the author's paraphrase, not Quranic text, though the source places it in Quranic brackets] ("let there be from You a hardening upon their hearts, and so a lack of faith from them"). Or [it is] by conjunction with His saying ﴿ليضلوا﴾, and the clause ﴿ربنا اطمس على أموالهم واشد على قلوبهم﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, «واشد» for واشدد] is a parenthetical clause (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position; or the interpreted maṣdar is jussive (majzūm) by being considered the answer to the supplication. حتى is a particle of termination (ghāya) and a preposition; يروا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive (majrūr), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to اشدد; the wāw is the agent; العذاب is the direct object; and الأليم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t:
﴿قال قد أجيبت دعوتكما﴾: the clause قد أجيبت is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech, what is said), and دعوتكما is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فاستقيما ولا تتبعان سبيل الذين لا يعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); استقيما is an imperative verb, and the alif is the agent; ولا تتبعان: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is prohibitive, and تتبعان is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the alif of the dual is the agent, and the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis (nūn al-tawkīd al-thaqīla); سبيل is the direct object; الذين is the muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct); and the clause لا يعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿وجاوزنا ببني إسرائيل البحر﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; جاوزنا is a verb and its agent; ﴿ببني إسرائيل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاوزنا, and the bāʾ is for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya), i.e. We made them cross the sea; and البحر is the direct object.
﴿فأتبعهم فرعون وجنوده بغيا وعدوا﴾: فأتبعهم: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أتبعهم is a verb and its direct object; فرعون is the agent; جنوده is conjoined to فرعون; بغيًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and عدوًا is conjoined to it; or ﴿بغيا وعدوا﴾ are two maṣdars in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. transgressing and acting with enmity.
﴿حتى إذا أدركه الغرق قال آمنت أنه لا إله إلا الذي آمنت به بنو إسرائيل﴾: حتى is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya) because the ﴿إذا﴾ of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya) occurs after it [Translator's note: so in the source; the author goes on to parse إذا as a future adverb whose clause has an apodosis, i.e. the conditional إذا, not the إذا of surprise], and it marks the end-point of the pursuit, i.e. his pursuit of them continued until the time the drowning overtook him; إذا is a future adverb (ẓarf mustaqbal); أدركه الغرق is a verb, a direct object and an agent, and the clause is in the position of a genitive as the second term of a genitive construct (bi-l-iḍāfa); the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿آمنت﴾ is what is said (maqūl al-qawl); أنّ together with what falls in its scope is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), the [implied] preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿آمنت﴾. ﴿لا إله إلا الذي﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, and إله is its noun; إلا is a particle of restriction (adāt ḥaṣr); الذي is a badal (substitute) for the position of ﴿لا﴾ together with its noun, according to the correct view, or for the omitted khabar, i.e. there is no god existing except ﴿الذي آمنت به بنو إسرائيل﴾; the clause آمنت is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنت﴾; and بنو إسرائيل is the agent of آمنت.
﴿وأنا من المسلمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and من المسلمين is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿آلآن وقد عصيت قبل وكنت من المفسدين﴾: آلآن: the hamza is for interrogation, and الآن is an adverb attached to an omitted [verb], its implied form being: «آلآن آمنت؟» ("Now you believe?"); ﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl, and قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); عصيت is a verb and its agent; ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from the genitive construct in wording but not in meaning; ﴿كنت من المفسدين﴾ is conjoined to عصيت; ﴿كنت﴾ is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; and ﴿من المفسدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿فاليوم ننجيك ببدنك لتكون لمن خلفك آية﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; اليوم is an adverb attached to ﴿ننجيك﴾; ببدنك is a ḥāl of the kāf, i.e. accompanied by your body; ولتكون: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and ﴿تكون﴾ is accusative by an implied أن, the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb being genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ننجيك; the noun of تكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and آية is its khabar; ﴿لمن خلفك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the adverb [خلفك] is attached to the [notion of] being settled (al-istiqrār) which is the ṣila of the relative noun.
﴿وإن كثيرا من الناس عن آياتنا لغافلون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and كثيرًا is its noun; ﴿من الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿كثيرًا﴾; عن آياتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿غافلون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غافلون is the khabar of إنّ; and the clause ﴿وإن كثيرًا...﴾ is parenthetical with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿ولقد بوأنا بني إسرائيل مبوأ صدق﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of verification; بوأنا is a verb and its agent; بني إسرائيل is the direct object; and ﴿مبوأ﴾ is the second direct object of ﴿بَوَّأ﴾, or a deputy of the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, absolute object), because it is a mīmī maṣdar, i.e. We settled them in a settling of truth.
﴿ورزقناهم من الطيبات فما اختلفوا حتى جاءهم العلم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رزقناهم is conjoined to بوأنا, and it is a verb, its agent and its direct object; من الطيبات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿رزقناهم﴾; فما: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ما is negative; اختلفوا is a verb and its agent; حتى is a particle of termination and a preposition; and جاءهم العلم is a verb, a direct object and an agent.
﴿إن ربك يقضي بينهم يوم القيامة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle; ربك is its noun; the clause يقضي is its khabar; بينهم is an adverb attached to ﴿يقضي﴾, and يوم القيامة is an adverb also attached to ﴿يقضي﴾; فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. judging between [them] in what; the clause كانوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; كانوا is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the wāw is its noun; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختلفون﴾; and the clause يختلفون is the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿فإن كنت في شك مما أنزلنا إليك﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional; ﴿كنت﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun, the verb being in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); في شك is its khabar; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿شك﴾; and the clause أنزلنا إليك is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فاسأل الذين يقرءون الكتاب من قبلك﴾: the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); اسأل is an imperative verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); الذين is the direct object; the clause يقرءون الكتاب is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; من قبلك is a ḥāl; and the clause ﴿فإن كنت في شك...﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿لقد جاءك الحق من ربك﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to an implied oath, and قد is a particle of verification; جاءك الحق is a verb, a direct object and an agent; and من ربك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءك﴾.
﴿فلا تكونن من الممترين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تكونن is jussive by لا in position (maḥallan), because it is indeclinable; its noun is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and من الممترين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t:
﴿ولا تكونن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تكونن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive by the prohibitive ﴿لا﴾; and the noun of ﴿تكونن﴾ is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت).
﴿من الذين كذبوا بآيات الله﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause كذبوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; بآيات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كذبوا﴾; and the Divine Name is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فتكون من الخاسرين﴾: the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya); ﴿تكون﴾ is a defective imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e. let there be no denial (kadhib) from you, and so [no] loss; and ﴿من الخاسرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿تكون﴾.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t: ﴿إن الذين حقت عليهم كلمت ربك لا يؤمنون﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and الذين is its noun; the clause حقت is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حقت﴾; ﴿كلمة﴾ is the agent, and ربك is the muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause لا يؤمنون is the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿ولو جاءتهم كل آية حتى يروا العذاب الأليم﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (ḥāliyya), and لو is conditional; جاءتهم كل آية: agent [Translator's note: so in the source, which appears to have dropped words; the sense is that جاءتهم is a verb and its direct object and كل is the agent]; ﴿حتى﴾ marks the end-point of the negation; يروا is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to يؤمنون; the wāw is the agent, and العذاب is the direct object; the seeing is visual, and therefore it takes only one object in the accusative; الأليم is an adjective; and the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, i.e. their faith will not benefit them then, just as it did not benefit Pharaoh.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿فلولا كانت قرية آمنت﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لولا is for urging (taḥḍīḍiyya); كانت قرية is a verb and its agent, because ﴿كان﴾ here is complete (tāmma); and the clause آمنت is an adjective of قرية.
﴿فنفعها إيمانها إلا قوم يونس﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; نفعها is conjoined to the adjective [clause], a conjoining of the effect upon the cause; إيمانها is the agent of نفعها; the clause may stand in place of an adjective for an indefinite noun; ﴿إلا قوم يونس﴾ is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil); and يونس is the muḍāf ilayhi, a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) because it is a proper name and foreign.
﴿لما آمنوا كشفنا عنهم عذاب الخزي في الحياة الدنيا ومتعناهم إلى حين﴾: لما is temporal (ḥīniyya) or linking (rābiṭa); آمنوا is a verb and its agent; the clause كشفنا has no grammatical position; عنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كشفنا﴾; عذاب الخزي is the direct object; في الحياة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, and الدنيا is an adjective; متعناهم is conjoined to ﴿كشفنا﴾; and إلى حين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متعناهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿ولو شاء ربك لآمن من في الأرض كلهم جميعا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; لو is conditional; شاء ربك is a verb and its agent, for ﴿آمن﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably meaning that the object of شاء is omitted and is understood from ﴿آمن﴾]; the lām occurs in the apodosis of ﴿لو﴾; the clause آمن has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; ﴿مَن﴾ is the agent of آمن; في الأرض is attached to an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila of ﴿من﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; كلهم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿من﴾; and جميعًا is accusative as a ḥāl of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿أفأنت تكره الناس حتى يكونوا مؤمنين﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction; أنت is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause after it is the khabar; the hamza is placed before the conjunction, or there is an omitted clause there; حتى is a particle of causation and a preposition; يكونوا is accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿تكره﴾; and مؤمنين is the khabar of يكونوا.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿وما كان لنفس أن تؤمن إلا بإذن الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negative; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb; ﴿لنفس﴾ is its fronted khabar; the maṣdar-forming أن together with what falls in its scope is its postponed noun; إلا is a particle of restriction; and بإذن الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمن﴾.
﴿ويجعل الرجس على الذين لا يعقلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿يجعل﴾ is conjoined to something implied, as if it were said: «فيأذن لبعضهم في الإيمان» ("so He permits some of them to believe"); يجعل is an imperfect verb, and الرجس is its object; على الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجعل﴾; and the clause لا يعقلون is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
