﴿قل انظروا ماذا في السماوات والأرض﴾: قل is an imperative verb, and the clause انظروا is what is said; ﴿ماذا﴾: ما is an interrogative, the mubtadaʾ, and ذا is a relative noun, the khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative because the governing word, which is ﴿انظروا﴾, is suspended (taʿlīq) [from operating] by the interrogative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted [verb] which is the ṣila of the relative noun, i.e. what is that which is settled in the heavens and the earth, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; or ﴿ماذا﴾ as a whole is an interrogative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ, and في السماوات is its khabar.
﴿وما تغني الآيات والنذر عن قوم لا يؤمنون﴾: the wāw is parenthetical. ما: negative, or an interrogative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as a deputy of the absolute object (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq). تغني: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. الآيات: the agent. النذر: conjoined to ﴿الآيات﴾. عن قوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تغني﴾. لا: negative. يؤمنون: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent. The clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾: in the position of a genitive as an adjective (naʿt) of ﴿قوم﴾. The clause ﴿ما تغني...﴾ is a parenthetical, appended (tadhyīlī) [clause] to the preceding clause, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿فهل ينتظرون إلا مثل أيام الذين خلوا من قبلهم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive with no grammatical position; هل is an interrogative particle; ينتظرون is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent; إلا is a particle of restriction; مثل is the object of ينتظرون; أيام is the muḍāf ilayhi, and الذين is a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause خلوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and من قبلهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلوا﴾ or to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿قل فانتظروا﴾: قل is an imperative verb; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; انتظروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the agent.
﴿إني معكم من المنتظرين﴾: إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun; ﴿من المنتظرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and the adverb [معكم] is attached to an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t:
﴿ثم ننجي رسلنا والذين آمنوا﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb wa-l-tarākhī); ننجي is an imperfect verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); the clause is conjoined to omitted speech, its implied form being: «نهلك الأمم، ثم ننجي رسلنا» ("We destroy the nations, then We save Our messengers"), by way of narrating past states; رسلنا is the direct object; الذين is conjoined to رسلنا; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿كذلك حقا علينا ننج المؤمنين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: «إنجاءً مثلَ ذلك الإنجاء ننجي المؤمنين» ("with a saving like that saving We save the believers"); ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿حقا﴾ is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, confirming the content of the clause, the implied form being: «حق ذلك حقا» ("that is truly due"); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حقا﴾; the clause ﴿حقًا علينا﴾ is parenthetical with no grammatical position; ﴿ننجي﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); and ﴿المؤمنين﴾ is the direct object.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿قل يا أيها الناس إن كنتم في شك من ديني﴾: قل is an imperative verb; ﴿يا أيها الناس﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أيّ is a vocative, an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); and الناس is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective, abrogating past verb, the protasis, and the tāʾ is its noun; ﴿في شك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar; and ﴿من ديني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿شك﴾.
﴿فلا أعبد الذين تعبدون من دون الله﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; لا is negative; أعبد is an imperfect verb whose agent is "I" (أنا); الذين is the object of أعبد; the clause ﴿تعبدون﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من دون الله﴾ is a ḥāl.
﴿ولكن أعبد الله الذي يتوفاكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect; أعبد is an imperfect verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the Divine Name is its object; الذي is an adjective; and the clause يتوفاكم is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأمرت أن أكون من المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أمرت is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the deputy agent; أن together with what falls in its scope is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن أكون» ("to be"), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أمرت﴾; the noun of أكون is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); and ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of أكون.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وأن أقم وجهك للدين حنيفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أن together with what falls in its scope is conjoined to what precedes it, as if it were said: «وقيل لي: وأقم» ("and it was said to me: and set"); ﴿أقم﴾ is an imperative verb; وجهك is the direct object; للدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أقم﴾; and حنيفًا is a ḥāl of الدين, or of الوجه.
﴿ولا تكونن من المشركين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تكونن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of a jussive by ﴿لا﴾; the noun of تكونن is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and من المشركين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t:
﴿ولا تدع من دون الله ما لا ينفعك ولا يضرك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive; تدع is an imperfect verb made jussive by لا, and the agent is "you" (أنت); من دون الله is a ḥāl; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative [noun], the direct object; the clause لا ينفعك is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ولا يضرك﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا ينفعك﴾.
﴿فإن فعلت فإنك إذا من الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; فعلت is in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is linking; إنّ is an abrogating particle, and the kāf is its noun; إذًا is a particle of answer and requital, inoperative (muhmal); and ﴿من الظالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿وإن يمسسك الله بضر فلا كاشف له إلا هو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يمسسك is the protasis, and the kāf is the direct object; ﴿الله﴾ is the agent; بضر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يمسسك﴾; the fāʾ is linking; لا is the lā of generic negation, and كاشف is its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; له is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كاشف﴾, and the khabar is omitted; or ﴿له﴾ is the khabar, i.e. existing for him; إلا is a particle of restriction; and هو is a badal of the omitted khabar.
﴿وإن يردك بخير فلا راد لفضله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يردك is the protasis, jussive, and the kāf is the direct object; بخير is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يردك﴾; the fāʾ is linking; لا is the lā of generic negation, and راد is its noun; لفضله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿راد﴾, and the khabar is omitted; or the preposition and its genitive noun are the khabar.
﴿يصيب به من يشاء من عباده﴾: the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position; the agent is "he" (هو); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يصيب﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the object of يصيب; the clause يشاء is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿من عباده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿وهو الغفور الرحيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ; الغفور is the first khabar, and الرحيم is the second khabar; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿قل يا أيها الناس﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أيّ is a vocative, an intended indefinite, indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention; and الناس is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿قد جاءكم الحق من ربكم﴾: قد جاءكم الحق is a verb, a direct object and an agent; and من ربكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاءكم﴾.
﴿فمن اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; مَن is conditional, and اهتدى is the protasis; or مَن is a relative [noun], the mubtadaʾ, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is linking; إنما is [إنّ] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [ما] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يهتدي is an imperfect verb, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); and لنفسه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يهتدي.
﴿ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها﴾: conjoined to the preceding clause, and it has the same i'rab; and عليها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضل﴾.
﴿وما أنا عليكم بوكيل﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative [ما] which operates like ليس; ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيل﴾; ﴿بوكيل﴾: the bāʾ is an extra (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿وكيل﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in wording; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿واتبع ما يوحى إليك﴾: the wāw is resumptive; اتبع is an imperative verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿ما﴾ is the direct object; the clause يوحي [Translator's note: so in the source, «يوحي»; the Quranic word is the passive يوحى] is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوحي﴾; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿واصبر حتى يحكم الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اصبر is an imperative verb conjoined to اتبع; حتى is a particle of termination and a preposition; يحكم is accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿اصبر﴾; and ﴿الله﴾ is its agent.
﴿وهو خير الحاكمين﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and خير الحاكمين is its khabar; and the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿والله يدعو إلى دار السلام﴾: the wāw is resumptive, «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يدعو» is the khabar (predicate), «﴿إلى دار السلام﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يدعو﴾», and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويهدي من يشاء إلى صراط مستقيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «يهدي» is conjoined to «يدعو», «﴿مَن﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the clause «يشاء» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position, «﴿إلى صراط﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يهدي﴾», and «مستقيم» is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿للذين أحسنوا الحسنى وزيادة﴾: «﴿للذين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), the clause «أحسنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «الحسنى» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «﴿وزيادة﴾» is conjoined to «الحسنى».
﴿ولا يرهق وجوههم قتر ولا ذلة﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is a conjunction and the clause «يرهق وجوههم» is conjoined to «الحسنى», in which case «﴿أن﴾» must be implied, and you may then read it in the accusative, or, if you wish, in the nominative; «لا» is negative, «يرهق وجوههم» is an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «﴿قتر﴾» is the fāʿil (agent), and «﴿ولا ذلة﴾» is conjoined to «قتر».
﴿أولئك أصحاب الجنة هم فيها خالدون﴾: «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ, «أصحاب» is the khabar, «الجنة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «﴿هم﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, «﴿فيها﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿خالدون﴾», «خالدون» is the khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿والذين كسبوا السيئات جزاء سيئة بمثلها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الذين» is conjoined by coordination (nasaq) to the first «الذين», i.e. "for those who did good is the best, and for those who earned evil deeds is the recompense of an evil deed with its like", so that the division is balanced, and this is the best of the analyses; or the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, «الذين» being a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «﴿جزاء سيئة بمثلها﴾»; «كسبوا السيئات», the clause made of the verb, the fāʿil (agent) and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «جزاء» is a second mubtadaʾ, «سيئة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «﴿بمثلها﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of «﴿جزاء﴾», i.e. «مقدر بمثلها» ("measured by its like").
﴿وترهقهم ذلة﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it has been said that this clause is conjoined to «كسبوا», and it has been said that the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl) and the clause «﴿ترهقهم ذلة﴾» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «ترهقهم» is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and «ذلة» is a nominative fāʿil.
﴿ما لهم من الله من عاصم﴾: «﴿ما﴾» is negative, «﴿لهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, «﴿من الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿عاصم﴾»; in «﴿من عاصم﴾», «﴿من﴾» is a connective (ṣila) preposition and «﴿عاصم﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative by position and genitive in form by «﴿مِن﴾».
﴿كأنما أغشيت وجوههم قطعا من الليل مظلما﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «كأنما» is [«كأنّ»] restrained by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), «أغشيت» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), «وجوههم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), «قطعًا» is a second mafʿūl bihi, «﴿من الليل﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿قطعا﴾», and «مظلمًا» is a ḥāl from «الليل», the governing word (ʿāmil) in it being either «﴿أغشيت﴾» or the verbal meaning in His words «من الليل».
﴿أولئك أصحاب النار هم فيها خالدون﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أولئك» is a mubtadaʾ, «أصحاب النار» is the khabar, and «هم فيها خالدون» is a nominal clause, a ḥāl from them.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ويوم نحشرهم جميعا﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb] understood from the previous ayah, i.e. «نفعل ذلك كله يوم نحشرهم» ("We do all that on the day We gather them"); the clause «نحشرهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [to «يوم»], and «جميعًا» is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ثم نقول للذين أشركوا مكانكم أنتم وشركاؤكم﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), «﴿نقول﴾» is conjoined to what the adverb is attached to, i.e. «نفعل ذلك كله ثم نقول» ("We do all that, then We say"), or conjoined to «نحشرهم»; «﴿للذين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿نقول﴾», the clause «أشركوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «مكانكم» is a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning «الزموا» ("keep [to your place]"), «أنتم» is a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in «مكانكم», and «شركاؤكم» is conjoined to it.
﴿فزيلنا بينهم وقال شركاؤهم ما كنتم إيانا تعبدون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, «زيلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿بينهم﴾» is an adverb attached to «زيلنا», and the clause «﴿فزيلنا بينهم﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «﴿قال شركاؤهم﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil, «ما» is negative, «﴿كنتم﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is its noun, «إيانا» is a detached pronoun, a fronted object of «تعبدون», and the clause «تعبدون» is accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿فكفى بالله شهيدا بيننا وبينكم﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «كفى» is a past verb, the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle, «﴿الله﴾» is the fāʿil (agent) by position, and «شهيدًا» is accusative as a tamyīz (specification) or as a ḥāl (circumstantial); if the noun is non-derived (jāmid), the accusative is as tamyīz.
﴿إن كنا عن عبادتكم لغافلين﴾: «إن» is lightened from the heavy [«إنّ»], its noun being an omitted pronoun, i.e. «إننا» ("indeed we"); «كنا» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), «﴿نا﴾» is its noun, «﴿عن عبادتكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿غافلين﴾», the lām is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), which is what rules out [taking it as] the negative «إن», «غافلين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنا», and the clause «﴿كنا...﴾» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿هنالك تبلو كل نفس ما أسلفت﴾: «هنالك» is a demonstrative in the position of an accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تبلو﴾»; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; «تبلو كل نفس» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «أسلفت» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.
﴿وردوا إلى الله مولاهم الحق﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ردوا» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), «﴿إلى الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ردوا», «مولاهم» is an adjective (ṣifa) or a badal (substitute) from «﴿الله﴾», and «الحق» is an adjective, because they used to take as patrons that whose lordship had no reality.
﴿وضل عنهم ما كانوا يفترون﴾: in «﴿وضل﴾» the wāw is a conjunction and «﴿ضل﴾» is conjoined to «ردوا»; «﴿عنهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ضل», «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil, «﴿كانوا﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, the clause «كانوا يفترون» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and the clause «يفترون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿قل من يرزقكم من السماء والأرض﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; «﴿مَن﴾» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يرزقكم» is the khabar (predicate), «﴿من السماء﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يرزقكم﴾», and «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماء».
﴿أمن يملك السمع والأبصار﴾: in «﴿أمَّن﴾», «أم» is disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل», for transitional turning (iḍrāb intiqālī) from one question to another, because it is not preceded by an interrogative hamza or a hamza of equalisation (taswiya); «مَن» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, the clause «يملك» is the khabar, «السمع» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «الأبصار» is conjoined to «السمع».
﴿ومن يخرج الحي من الميت ويخرج الميت من الحي ومن يدبر الأمر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «مَن» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ; «﴿يخرج الحي﴾»: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), and «الحي» is a mafʿūl bihi; «﴿من الميت﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يخرج﴾», and the clause «﴿يخرج الحي من الميت﴾» is the khabar of «مَن»; «﴿يخرج الميت﴾» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, «الميت» is a mafʿūl bihi, «﴿من الحي﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the second verb «﴿يخرج﴾», and the clause «﴿يخرج الميت من الحي﴾» is conjoined to «﴿يخرج الحي من الميت﴾». In «﴿ومَن﴾» the wāw is a conjunction and «مَن» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ; «﴿يدبر﴾» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being «هو» ("He"), «﴿الأمر﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «﴿يدبر الأمر﴾» is the khabar of «مَن».
﴿فسيقولون الله﴾: the fāʾ is in the apodosis (jawāb) of an implied condition, i.e. «إن سألتهم فسيقولون» ("if you ask them, they will say"); «يقولون» is a verb and its fāʿil, and «﴿الله﴾» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. «هو الله» ("He is Allah"), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being «الله يفعل هذه الأشياء كلها» ("Allah does all these things"); the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فقل أفلا تتقون﴾: in «﴿فقل﴾» the fāʾ is a conjunction, «قل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being «أنت» ("you"), and the clause «﴿قل﴾» is conjoined to the first «﴿قل﴾»; in «﴿أفلا﴾» the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something implied, i.e. «أتعلمون ذلك فلا تتقون» ("do you know that, and yet not fear [Him]?"), «﴿لا﴾» is negative, and «﴿تتقون﴾» is an imperfect verb, the wāw of the plural being the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿فذلكم الله ربكم الحق﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿الله﴾» is the khabar (predicate), «ربكم» is a badal (substitute) from «الله» or an adjective (ṣifa), and «الحق» is an adjective of «﴿ربكم﴾»; or «﴿الله﴾» is a second mubtadaʾ, «ربكم» is its khabar, and the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿فماذا بعد الحق إلا الضلال فأنى تصرفون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «﴿ماذا﴾» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar of the interrogative «﴿ما﴾»; «﴿بعد﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «الضلال» is a badal from «ذا», and the interrogation here also has the meaning of negation; the fāʾ is a conjunction, «﴿أنى﴾» is an interrogative noun meaning «كيف» ("how"), in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «تصرفون», and «تصرفون» is an imperfect verb in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿كذلك حقت كلمت ربك على الذين فسقوا أنهم لا يؤمنون﴾: in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being «حقًا مثلَ ذلك حقت كلمة ربك» ("with a being-fulfilled like that, the word of your Lord was fulfilled"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. The reference of «﴿ذلك﴾» is to their being turned away from the truth after acknowledging it in His words «﴿فسيقولون الله﴾»; it has also been said that the reference is to the truth. «﴿وحقت كلمة ربك﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿على الذين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿حقت﴾», the clause «﴿فسقوا﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and «أن» together with what falls within its scope is a badal (substitute) from «﴿كلمة ربك﴾», i.e. the absence of faith became binding upon them; the clause «﴿لا يؤمنون﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن». [Translator's note: the source quotes «وحقت كلمة ربك» with a wāw and the spelling «كلمة», whereas the ayah reads «حقت كلمت ربك».]

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿قل هل من شركائكم من يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده﴾: «هل» is an interrogative particle, «﴿من شركائكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مَن» is a relative noun, a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يبدأ الخلق» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position, and «ثم» is a conjunction [joining] to «يبدأ».
﴿قل الله يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده فأنى تؤفكون﴾: «﴿الله﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «يبدأ الخلق» is its khabar, and the nominal clause is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl); «ثم يعيده» is conjoined to «يبدأ»; the fāʾ is a conjunction, «أنى» is an interrogative noun meaning «كيف» ("how"), in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «تؤفكون» is an imperfect verb in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), the wāw being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿قل هل من شركائكم من يهدي إلى الحق﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, «هل» is an interrogative particle, «﴿من شركائكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مَن» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «يهدي» is an imperfect verb transitive to two [objects]; the first object has been omitted from the three verbs, the implied form being «هل من شركائكم من يهدي غيره إلى الحق؟» ("is there among your partners one who guides another to the truth?"). «﴿قل الله يهدي للحق﴾»: «الله» is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يهدي للحق» is its khabar.
﴿أفمن يهدي إلى الحق أحق أن يتبع﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, «من» is a mubtadaʾ, «أحق» is its khabar, «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle, «يتبع» is in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), and the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is accusative by removal of the preposition, or [genitive as] muḍāf ilayhi after removal of the preposition, i.e. «أحق بالاتباع» ("more worthy of being followed").
﴿أمن لا يهدي إلا أن يهدى﴾: «أم» is a conjunction, «من» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «لا يهدي» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position, «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «أن» together with what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the exception is emptied (mufarragh) from the most general of circumstances, i.e. he does not guide, or is not guided, in any circumstance except in the circumstance of his being guided, i.e. of others guiding him; and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being «أحق» ("more worthy"). [Translator's note: the source has «وأنا وما في حيزها», evidently a misprint for «وأن وما في حيزها».]
﴿فما لكم كيف تحكمون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «ما» is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ, «﴿لكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted khabar, «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, «تحكمون» is an imperfect verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent), and the clause «﴿تحكمون﴾» is a ḥāl from the pronoun of address in «﴿لكم﴾».

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿وما يتبع أكثرهم إلا ظنا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «ما» is negative, «يتبع أكثرهم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «ظنًّا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن الظن لا يغني من الحق شيئا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «الظن» is its noun, the clause «لا يغني» is its khabar (predicate), «﴿من الحق﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted ḥāl (circumstantial), and «شيئًا» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. something of availing, or a mafʿūl bihi, «يغني» being made to include the meaning of «يدفع» ("to ward off").
﴿إن الله عليم بما يفعلون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, «عليم» is its khabar, «﴿بما﴾» is attached to «﴿عليم﴾», and the clause «يفعلون» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of «ما», whether it is relative or maṣdariyya.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿وما كان هذا القرآن أن يفترى من دون الله﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «ما» is negative, «كان» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), «هذا» is its noun, «القرآن» is a badal (substitute) from «﴿هذا﴾», and «أن» together with what falls within its scope is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», i.e. «افتراء» ("a fabrication").
﴿ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لكن» is lightened and inoperative (muhmala), «تصديق» is conjoined to the interpreted «افتراء», «﴿الذي﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «﴿بين﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, the ṣila clause having no grammatical position, and «يديه» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿وتفصيل الكتاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «تفصيل» is conjoined to «تصديق».
﴿لا ريب فيه﴾: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «ريب» is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and «﴿فيه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «﴿لا﴾».
﴿من رب العالمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «﴿لا ريب فيه﴾» is a ḥāl, and a ḥāl from the muḍāf ilayhi is permissible here because it is an object in meaning. The meaning is: and a detailed exposition of the Book, doubt being negated from it. It has been said that it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and it has been said that it is parenthetical between «﴿تصديق﴾» and «﴿من رب العالمين﴾», with no grammatical position, the implied form being «ولكن تصديق الذين بين يديه من رب العالمين». [Translator's note: the source writes «الذين» here for the ayah's «الذي».]

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿أم يقولون افتراه﴾: «أم» is a disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction, so it has the meaning of «بل» plus the interrogative hamza, the implied form being «بل أيقولون افتراه؟» ("nay, do they say he fabricated it?"), the hamza being for interrogation of disapproval; or «﴿أم﴾» is connected (muttaṣila), in which case a clause must be implied so that the balance [of the two alternatives] is sound, the implied form being «أيقرون به أم يقولون: افتراه؟» ("do they acknowledge it, or do they say: he fabricated it?"); the clause «﴿افتراه﴾» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿قل فأتوا بسورة مثله﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference), «ائتوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿بسورة﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿ائتوا﴾», and «﴿مثله﴾» is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ادعوا» is conjoined to «فائتوا», the wāw is the fāʿil, «من» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the clause «استطعتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position, «﴿من دون الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «إن» is conditional, «كنتم» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», «صادقين» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. «فائتوا وادعوا» ("then bring and call").

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿بل كذبوا بما لم يحيطوا بعلمه ولما يأتهم تأويله﴾: «بل» is a particle of turning (iḍrāb) and conjunction, «كذبوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿بما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿كذبوا﴾», and the clause «لم يحيطوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position; the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. they denied it while they had not understood what they denied, nor had their minds attained it; «لما» is a jussive particle, «﴿يأتهم﴾» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «﴿لما﴾», the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «﴿تأويله﴾» is the fāʿil of «﴿يأتهم﴾»; or the wāw is for conjunction and the clause is conjoined to «لم يحيطوا», thus falling under the ruling of the ṣila, i.e. nay, they denied what they did not encompass in knowledge and what its interpretation had not reached them.
﴿كذلك كذب الذين من قبلهم فانظر كيف كان عاقبة الظالمين﴾: in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being «تكذيبًا مثلَ ذلك التكذيب كذَّب الذين من قبلهم» ("with a denial like that denial, those before them denied"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «﴿كذب الذين﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil, «﴿من قبلهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of «الذين», the ṣila clause having no grammatical position; in «فانظر» the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted, i.e. «فأهلكنا فانظر» ("so We destroyed [them]; so look"); «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the place of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the verb «﴿فانظر﴾» cannot validly govern it, because what precedes an interrogative does not govern it; «عاقبة» is its noun, and «الظالمين» is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿ومنهم من يؤمن به ومنهم من لا يؤمن به وربك أعلم بالمفسدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿منهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مَن» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يؤمن به» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿مَن﴾», with no grammatical position, and the clause «ومنهم من لا يؤمن» is conjoined to the preceding clause; «ربك» is a mubtadaʾ, «أعلم» is the khabar, and «بالمفسدين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أعلم».

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وإن كذبوك فقل لي عملي ولكم عملكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «إن» is conditional, «كذبوك» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and it is in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); in «﴿فقل﴾» the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), because what follows it is a request clause (ṭalabiyya), and «قل» is an imperative verb; «﴿لي﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «عملي» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿لكم عملكم﴾» is conjoined, and the clause «لي عملي» is in the position of an accusative as the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿أنتم بريئون مما أعمل﴾: «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ, «بريئون» is the khabar, «﴿مما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿بريئون﴾», and the clause «أعمل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأنا بريء مما تعملون﴾: conjoined to what preceded.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ومنهم من يستمعون إليك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿منهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مَن» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «يستمعون» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «من» if it is a qualified indefinite, i.e. «ناس يستمعون» ("people who listen"), and a ṣila (relative clause) if it is relative.
﴿أفأنت تسمع الصم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and «أنت» is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿ولو كانوا لا يعقلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لو» is a non-jussive conditional particle, «كانوا» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and the clause «لا يعقلون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿ومنهم من ينظر إليك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining to what preceded, «﴿منهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «﴿مَن﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), «﴿ينظر﴾» is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), the pronoun here being construed according to the wording (lafẓ) of «مَن» [i.e. singular], and «﴿إليك﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿ينظر﴾».
﴿أفأنت تهدي العمي ولو كانوا لا يبصرون﴾: conjoined to what preceded. The apodosis (jawāb) of «﴿لو﴾» in both clauses is omitted, because His words «﴿أفأنت تسمع الصم﴾» and His words «﴿أفأنت تهدي العمي﴾» indicate it; each of the two is conjoined to an implied clause corresponding to it, and both are in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of the preceding verb, i.e. "Can you make the deaf hear, if they understood and if they did not understand? Can you guide the blind, if they saw and if they did not see?" — i.e. you cannot make them hear nor guide them in any case.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿إن الله لا يظلم الناس شيئا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «﴿الله﴾» is its noun, the clause «لا يظلم» is its khabar (predicate), «الناس» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «شيئًا» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. anything of wrongdoing, or a second object of «يظلم», in the sense of: He does not diminish people anything of their deeds.
﴿ولكن الناس أنفسهم يظلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), «لكن» is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) governing the accusative, «الناس» is its noun, «أنفسهم» is a fronted object of «يظلمون», and the clause «يظلمون» is the khabar of «لكن».

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿ويوم يحشرهم كأن لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من النهار﴾: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يتعارفون﴾», the clause «يحشرهم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [to «يوم»], «كأن» is lightened from the heavy [«كأنّ»], its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause «لم يلبثوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأن»; the clause «لم يلبثوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the hāʾ in «يحشرهم»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «ساعة» is an adverb attached to «﴿يلبثوا﴾», and «من النهار» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «ساعة». [Translator's note: as written, the source assigns the ḥāl role to «لم يلبثوا»; on its analysis it is the whole «كأن» clause that is the ḥāl.]
﴿يتعارفون بينهم﴾: the clause is a ḥāl from the wāw in «يلبثوا», making it an overlapping (mutadākhila) ḥāl, or from the pronoun in «يحشرهم», making it a successive (mutarādifa) ḥāl; «﴿بينهم﴾» is an adverb attached to «﴿يتعارفون﴾».
﴿قد خسر الذين كذبوا بلقاء الله﴾: «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «خسر الذين» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the clause «كذبوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «﴿بلقاء الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿كذبوا﴾», and the clause «﴿قد خسر...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وما كانوا مهتدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «كانوا» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, and «مهتدين» is its khabar; it is conjoined to «﴿قد خسر﴾», or to the ṣila of «﴿الذين﴾».

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وإما نرينك بعض الذي نعدهم أو نتوفينك﴾: «إن» is conditional, «ما» is connective (ṣila), «نرينك» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن» ("We"); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «بعض» is a second object, «الذي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the clause «نعدهم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position, «﴿أو﴾» is a conjunction, and «نتوفينك» is conjoined to «نرينك».
﴿فإلينا مرجعهم ثم الله شهيد على ما يفعلون﴾: the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), «﴿إلينا﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «مرجعهم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «ثم» is a conjunction, not for sequence in time but for sequence in what is reported; «﴿الله﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, «شهيد» is the khabar, «﴿على ما يفعلون﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شهيد», and the clause «يفعلون» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ولكل أمة رسول﴾: «﴿لكل﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «أمة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «رسول» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فإذا جاء رسولهم قضي بينهم بالقسط وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to the [implied] adjective of «رسول», i.e. «يُبعث إليهم فإذا…» ("he is sent to them, and when…"); «إذا» is an adverb of the future [Translator's note: the source has «طرف», evidently a misprint for «ظرف» ("adverb")], the clause «جاء رسولهم» is muḍāf ilayhi to it, the clause «قضي» has no grammatical position, «﴿بينهم﴾» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «قضي», and «﴿بالقسط﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of «قضي»; in «﴿وهم﴾» the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial, «هم» is a mubtadaʾ, and the clause «لا يظلمون» is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿ويقولون متى هذا الوعد إن كنتم صادقين﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), «﴿متى﴾» is an interrogative of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), «هذا» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الوعد» is a badal (substitute); «إن» is conditional, «كنتم» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», «صادقين» is its khabar, and the apodosis is omitted, i.e. «فمتى هذا الوعد؟» ("then when is this promise?").

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿قل لا أملك لنفسي ضرا ولا نفعا إلا ما شاء الله﴾: the clause «لا أملك» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl), «لنفسي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أملك», «ضرًّا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «ولا نفعًا» is conjoined to «﴿ضرًّا﴾», «إلا» is a particle of exception, or of restriction (ḥaṣr) because of the presence of the negation, and «ما» is a relative noun, the excepted [term]; it has been said that the exception is connected (muttaṣil), and it has been said that it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); if «﴿إلا﴾» is for restriction, then «﴿ما﴾» is a badal (substitute) from «﴿ضرًّا﴾» and «﴿نفعا﴾»; and the clause «شاء الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.
﴿لكل أمة أجل﴾: the completion of the speech-content; «﴿لكل﴾» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «أمة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «﴿أجل﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إذا جاء أجلهم فلا يستأخرون ساعة ولا يستقدمون﴾: «إذا» is an adverb of the future, the clause «جاء» is muḍāf ilayhi to it, «أجلهم» is the fāʿil (agent) of «جاء», the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), «﴿لا﴾» is negative, the clause «يستأخرون» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of «إذا», «ساعة» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «﴿يستأخرون﴾», and «ولا يستقدمون» is conjoined to «فلا يستأخرون».

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم إن أتاكم عذابه بياتا أو نهارا﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being «أنت» ("you"), i.e. Muhammad ﷺ, and the clause «أرأيتم» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl); in «أرأيتم» the hamza is for interrogation, «رأى» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; «أرأيتم» here means «أخبروني» ("tell me") and is transitive to two objects; its first object is omitted, and the conditional clause cannot validly take its place; «إن» is conditional, «أتاكم» is a past verb in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb) is the interrogative clause, with a fāʾ implied in the nominal clause; «بياتًا» is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿أتاكم﴾», and «﴿أو نهارًا﴾» is conjoined to it.
﴿ماذا يستعجل منه المجرمون﴾: «﴿ما﴾» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «﴿ذا﴾» is a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, the meaning being: "what is it that the criminals seek to hasten of it?"; «يستعجل» is an imperfect verb, «منه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يستعجل﴾», «المجرمون» is the fāʿil, and the clause «﴿يستعجل﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «﴿ماذا﴾» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «﴿يستعجل﴾». The interrogative clause is in the position of an accusative as the second object of «﴿أرأيتم﴾».

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿أثم إذا ما وقع آمنتم به آلآن وقد كنتم به تستعجلون﴾: in «﴿أثم﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval and «ثم» is a conjunction; «﴿إذا﴾» is an adverb of future time that includes the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿آمنتم﴾», «﴿ما﴾» is connective (ṣila), the clause «﴿وقع﴾» is in the position of a genitive by being annexed to it, and the clause «﴿آمنتم به﴾» has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; in «﴿آلآن﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, and «الآن» is an adverb attached to an omitted [verb] understood from the context of the speech, its implied form being «آلآن به تؤمنون» ("now you believe in it?"); in «﴿وقد﴾» the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl) and «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «﴿كنتم﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tāʾ is the noun of «كان», and the mīm is the sign of the plural; «﴿به﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تستعجلون﴾», and the clause «﴿تستعجلون﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «﴿كنتم﴾».

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿ثم قيل للذين ظلموا ذوقوا عذاب الخلد هل تجزون إلا بما كنتم تكسبون﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction. «﴿قيل﴾» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive). «﴿للذين﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿قيل﴾». The clause «﴿ظلموا﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause «﴿ذوقوا﴾» is in the position of a nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). «عذاب» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «الخلد» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «هل» is an interrogative particle. «تجزون» is an imperfect verb and the nāʾib fāʿil. «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). «﴿بما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تجزون﴾». The clause «﴿كنتم﴾» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position. The clause «﴿تكسبون﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان».

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ويستنبئونك أحق هو قل إي وربي﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «يستنبئونك» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in «﴿أحق﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval mixed with mockery, «حق» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «﴿هو﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi of «﴿يستنبئونك﴾»; it has also been said that the clause is in the position of an accusative by «﴿يقولون﴾» [implied], «﴿يستنبئونك﴾» being transitive to one [object], whereas the basic usage of «استنبأ» is to be transitive to two objects. «﴿قل﴾» is an imperative verb, «﴿إي﴾» is a particle of answer, and in «وربي» the wāw is for the oath and «ربي» is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of the oath.
﴿إنه لحق وما أنتم بمعجزين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the wāw is a conjunction joining to the answer of the oath, or resumptive, the clause after it being resumptive with no grammatical position; «﴿ما﴾» is the Ḥijāzī negative that works like «ليس», «﴿أنتم﴾» is the noun of «ما», and in «﴿بمعجزين﴾» the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition and «﴿معجزين﴾» is the khabar of «ما», accusative by position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿ولو أن لكل نفس ظلمت ما في الأرض لافتدت به﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «لو» is a conditional of impossibility (imtināʿ), «أن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «﴿لكل﴾» is the fronted khabar (predicate) of «أن», «نفس» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the clause «ظلمت» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «نفس», and «ما» is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the noun of «أن»; «أن» together with what falls within its scope is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb, i.e. «لو ثبت ذلك» ("if that were established"); «﴿في الأرض﴾» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position; the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of «لو», and «افتدت به» is a verbal clause with no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وأسروا الندامة لما رأوا العذاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «أسروا الندامة» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «لما» is linking (rābiṭa) or temporal (ḥīniyya), the clause «رأوا» is muḍāf ilayhi to it, the wāw is the fāʿil, and «العذاب» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وقضي بينهم بالقسط﴾: the speech is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined; «قضي» is a past verb in the form of that whose agent is not named (passive), the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), «بينهم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قضي», and «بالقسط» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿هم﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «لا يظلمون» is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿ألا إن لله ما في السماوات والأرض﴾: «ألا» is a particle of alerting (tanbīh) and opening (istiftāḥ), «لله» is the fronted khabar (predicate) of «إن», «ما» is its postponed noun, and «في السماوات والأرض» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.
﴿ألا إن وعد الله حق﴾: «ألا» is emphasis of the first «﴿ألا﴾», «إن» and its noun [follow], and «حق» is its khabar. [Translator's note: the source has «واسهما», evidently a misprint for «واسمها» ("and its noun").]
﴿ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), the clause after it being in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive, the clause after it being resumptive with no grammatical position; «لكن» is an abrogating particle, «أكثرهم» is its noun, and the clause «لا يعلمون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿هو يحيي ويميت وإليه ترجعون﴾: «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «يحيي» is the khabar (predicate), the clause «يميت» is conjoined, and «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿ترجعون﴾».

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿يا أيها الناس﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle for [addressing] one at a middle distance, «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative (naṣb), «ها» is for alerting (tanbīh), and «الناس» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿أي﴾».
﴿قد جاءتكم موعظة من ربكم﴾: «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq), «جاءتكم موعظة» is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent), and «من ربكم» is an adjective of «موعظة», «﴿من﴾» being partitive (tabʿīḍ); or it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿جاءتكم﴾», in which case it is for the beginning [of the goal] (ibtidāʾ).
﴿وشفاء لما في الصدور وهدى ورحمة للمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «شفاء» is conjoined to «موعظة», and «﴿لما في الصدور﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of «شفاء»; or the lām is a connective (ṣila) particle and «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi, «في الصدور» being the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position; «هدى ورحمة» are likewise conjoined, and «للمؤمنين» is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿قل بفضل الله وبرحمته فبذلك فليفرحوا هو خير مما يجمعون﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted; the original form of the speech is «ليفرحوا بفضل الله وبرحمته فبذلك» ("let them rejoice in the bounty of Allah and in His mercy, so in that"), the fāʾ conveying the meaning of causation, i.e. "in the bounty of Allah and in His mercy, so let them rejoice"; the first fāʾ is of requital (jazāʾiyya) and the second is for causation. In «﴿فبذلك﴾» the fāʾ is a conjunction and «﴿بذلك﴾» is conjoined to «﴿بفضل الله﴾»; it has also been said that the fāʾ entering upon «﴿بذلك﴾» is connective (ṣila) and «﴿بذلك﴾» is a badal (substitute) from «﴿بفضل﴾». As for the fāʾ entering upon «﴿فليفرحوا﴾», it is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference), because it enters for the meaning of condition, as though it were said: "If they rejoice in anything, let them single these out for rejoicing." «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «خير» is the khabar (predicate), «﴿مما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خير», and «يجمعون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم ما أنزل الله لكم من رزق﴾: in «﴿أرأيتم﴾» the hamza is for interrogation, «رأى» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); in «﴿ما أنزل الله﴾», «ما» is a relative noun, the object of «﴿أرأيتم﴾» or of «﴿أنزل﴾», the clause «أنزل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. «أنزله الله» ("[which] Allah sent down"); or «ما» is interrogative, in the position of an accusative by «﴿أنزل﴾», in which case it suspends (tuʿalliq) «﴿أرأيتم﴾» from governing; or «ما» is interrogative, in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «﴿آلله أذن لكم﴾» is the khabar (predicate); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿أنزل﴾», and «من رزق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فجعلتم منه حراما وحلالا قل آلله أذن لكم أم على الله تفترون﴾: «فجعلتم» is conjoined to «أنزل»; «جعلتم» is a verb and its fāʿil, «﴿منه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿جعلتم﴾», «حرامًا» is the object of «جعلتم», and «حلالًا» is conjoined; in «﴿آلله﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, «﴿الله﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, the clause «أذن» is its khabar, and «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أذن﴾»; «﴿أم﴾» is disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the hamza, the implied form being «بل أتفترون على الله؟» ("nay, do you fabricate against Allah?"), the interrogation being for disapproval; or it is connected (muttaṣila), the implied form being: "Which of the two things happened — Allah's permission to you in that, or your fabrication against Him?" — and perhaps its being connected is more apparent; «﴿على الله﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يفترون﴾». [Translator's note: the source writes «يفترون»; the verb in the ayah is «تفترون».]

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وما ظن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), «ظن» is its khabar (predicate), «الذين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the clause «يفترون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «على الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يفترون﴾», «الكذب» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «يوم القيامة» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «الظن»; the two objects of «الظن» are replaced by an implied «أن» and what follows it.
﴿إن الله لذو فضل على الناس ولكن أكثرهم لا يشكرون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «ذو فضل» is its khabar, and «على الناس» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿فضل﴾»; in «﴿ولكن﴾» the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl), the clause after it being in the position of an accusative, or resumptive, the clause after it being resumptive with no grammatical position; «لكن» is an abrogating particle, «أكثرهم» is its noun, and the clause «لا يشكرون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وما تكون في شأن وما تتلو منه من قرآن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «تكون» is an incomplete, abrogating imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), the noun of «تكون» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» ("you"), and «﴿في شأن﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «تكون»; in «﴿وما﴾» the wāw is a conjunction and «ما» is negative; «تتلو» is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent, its implied form being «أنت», and «منه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تتلو﴾»; the pronoun refers back to the Qurʾān, or to «الشأن» ("the affair"), in which case «من» is causal, i.e. on account of the affair in which you were engaged; «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle, and «قرآن» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by position.
﴿ولا تعملون من عمل إلا كنا عليكم شهودا إذ تفيضون فيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ولا تعملون» is conjoined to what preceded, «﴿من﴾» is a connective particle, «﴿عمل﴾» is genitive in form and a mafʿūl bihi by position, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), «﴿كنا﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb, «﴿نا﴾» is the noun of «كان» [Translator's note: the source has «كا», evidently a misprint for «كان»], «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to His word «﴿شهودًا﴾», i.e. «شاهدين» ("witnesses"), «شهودًا» is the khabar of «كنا», «﴿إذ﴾» is an adverb of past time attached to «﴿شهودًا﴾», the clause «﴿تفيضون﴾» is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it, and «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تفيضون﴾».
﴿وما يعزب عن ربك من مثقال ذرة في الأرض ولا في السماء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «عن ربك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿يعزب﴾», «من» is a connective particle, «مثقال ذرة» is the fāʿil of «يعزب» by position, «﴿في الأرض﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «﴿مثقال ذرة﴾», or an adjective (ṣifa), and «ولا في السماء» is conjoined.
﴿ولا أصغر من ذلك ولا أكبر إلا في كتاب مبين﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «أصغر» is its noun, «﴿من ذلك﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿أصغر﴾», «﴿ولا أكبر﴾» is conjoined to «﴿ولا أصغر﴾», «إلا» is a particle of restriction, «﴿في كتاب مبين﴾» is the khabar of «﴿لا﴾», and «مبين» is an adjective of «﴿كتاب﴾».

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿ألا إن أولياء الله لا خوف عليهم﴾: «ألا» is a particle of alerting (tanbīh); in «﴿إن أولياء الله لا خوف عليهم﴾», «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «أولياء» is its noun, «لا» is negative, «خوف» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and beginning with it, though it is indefinite, is permissible because it is negated; «﴿عليهم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause «﴿لا خوف عليهم﴾» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «إن».
﴿ولا هم يحزنون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negative, «هم» is a mubtadaʾ, and «يحزنون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw of the plural being the fāʿil (agent); the clause «﴿يحزنون﴾» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «﴿هم﴾».

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿الذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون﴾: «الذين» is accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿أولياء الله﴾», or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «هم الذين آمنوا» ("they are those who believed"), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the coming clause «﴿لهم البشرى﴾»; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «كانوا يتقون» is conjoined to the ṣila, and the clause «يتقون» is the khabar of «كان». [Translator's note: the source calls «الذين» accusative as an adjective of «أولياء الله», which is the noun of «إنّ».]

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿لهم البشرى في الحياة الدنيا﴾: «لهم» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «البشرى» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), «في الحياة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البشرى», the governing word (ʿāmil) in the ḥāl being the [implied] "being established" (istiqrār) in «﴿لهم﴾», and «الدنيا» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿الحياة﴾»; the clause «﴿لهم البشرى﴾» is resumptive with no grammatical position, or in the position of a nominative as a khabar if you make «﴿الذين﴾» in the previous ayah a mubtadaʾ.
﴿وفي الآخرة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «في الآخرة» is conjoined to «﴿في الحياة الدنيا﴾».
﴿لا تبديل لكلمات الله﴾: «لا» is the lā of generic negation, «تبديل» is its noun, and «﴿لكلمات﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of «﴿لا﴾». The clause «﴿لا تبديل...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك هو الفوز العظيم﴾: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ, «هو» is a second mubtadaʾ, «الفوز» is the khabar of «﴿هو﴾», the clause is the khabar of «ذلك», and «العظيم» is an adjective of «الفوز». The clause «﴿ذلك هو...﴾» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿ولا يحزنك قولهم إن العزة لله جميعا هو السميع العليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is prohibitive, «يحزنك» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «قولهم» is the fāʿil (agent); «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «العزة» is its noun, «﴿لله﴾» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العزة», or tawkīd (emphasis); «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «السميع» is its first khabar, and «العليم» its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿ألا إن لله من في السماوات ومن في الأرض﴾: «ألا» is a particle of alerting (tanbīh), «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «﴿لله﴾» is its fronted khabar (predicate), «مَن» is its postponed noun, «في السماوات» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «مَن», with no grammatical position, and «﴿من في الأرض﴾» is conjoined to «﴿من في السماوات﴾».
﴿وما يتبع الذين يدعون من دون الله شركاء﴾: «ما» is negative, «﴿يتبع الذين﴾» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), the clause «يدعون» is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «من دون الله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شركاء» because it precedes it, «شركاء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «﴿يتبع﴾», and the object of «يدعون» is omitted because the meaning is understood, the implied form being «وما يتبع الذين يدعون من دون الله آلهة شركاء» ("those who call upon gods besides Allah do not follow [real] partners"); or «﴿ما﴾» is interrogative, accusative by what follows it, i.e. "what do they follow?"; or «﴿ما﴾» is relative, conjoined to «من», as though He says: "And to Allah belongs what those who call upon partners besides Allah follow", i.e. and their partners belong to Him; or this relative «﴿ما﴾» is in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) with an omitted khabar, its implied form being «والذي يتبعه المشركون باطل» ("and what the polytheists follow is false").
﴿إن يتبعون إلا الظن﴾: «إن» is negative, «يتبعون» is a verb and its fāʿil, «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «الظن» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وإن هم إلا يخرصون﴾: «إن» is also negative, «﴿هم﴾» is a mubtadaʾ, «إلا» is a particle of restriction, and the clause «يخرصون» is the khabar of «﴿هم﴾».

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿هو الذي جعل لكم الليل لتسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا﴾: «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الذي» is the khabar (predicate), the clause «جعل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, «﴿لكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿جعل﴾», and «الليل» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in «﴿لتسكنوا﴾» the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «تسكنوا» is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن», the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are either attached to an omitted mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or [are] a second object; «﴿فيه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تسكنوا﴾», «النهار» is conjoined to «الليل», and «مبصرًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second object if «﴿جعل﴾» has the meaning of "making into" (taṣyīr) and so is transitive to two objects.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يسمعون﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «﴿في ذلك﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar of «﴿إن﴾», the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «آيات» is the postponed noun of «إن», «﴿لقوم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of «آيات», and the clause «يسمعون» is an adjective of «﴿قوم﴾».

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿قالوا اتخذ الله ولدا سبحانه﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «اتخذ الله ولدًا» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the clause being the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl), and «سبحانه» is a stand-in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb, the hāʾ being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿هو الغني له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض﴾: «﴿هو﴾» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «الغني» is its khabar (predicate), «له» is a fronted khabar, «ما» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, «في السماوات» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and «ما في الأرض» is conjoined to «ما في السماوات».
﴿إن عندكم من سلطان بهذا﴾: «إن» is negative, «عندكم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar, «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle, «سلطان» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative by position and genitive in form, and «﴿بهذا﴾» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «﴿سلطان﴾».
﴿أتقولون على الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval, «تقولون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, «على الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تقولون﴾», «﴿ما﴾» is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause «لا تعلمون» is the ṣila of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿قل إن الذين يفترون على الله الكذب لا يفلحون﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) implied as «أنت» ("you"); in «﴿إن الذين﴾», «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «يفترون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position, «على الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿يفترون﴾», «الكذب» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «لا يفلحون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿متاع في الدنيا ثم إلينا مرجعهم ثم نذيقهم العذاب الشديد بما كانوا يكفرون﴾: «متاع» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. «ذاك» ("that") or «هو» ("it"), and «﴿في الدنيا﴾» is an adjective (ṣifa); or «﴿متاع﴾» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, the implied form being «لهم متاع» ("for them is enjoyment"); «ثم» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), «إلينا» is a fronted khabar, «مرجعهم» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, «ثم» is a conjunction, «نذيقهم» is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «العذاب» is a second mafʿūl bihi, and «الشديد» is an adjective; in «﴿بما﴾» the bāʾ is a preposition of causation and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e. because of their being disbelievers, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿نذيقهم﴾».

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿واتل عليهم نبأ نوح إذ قال لقومه﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «اتل» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) being «أنت» ("you"), «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿اتل﴾», «نبأ» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «نوح» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), «﴿إذ﴾» is an adverb of past time attached to «﴿نبأ﴾», and the clause «﴿قال لقومه﴾» is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it.
﴿يا قوم إن كان كبر عليكم مقامي وتذكيري بآيات الله فعلى الله توكلت﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, «قوم» is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the speaker; «إن» is conditional, «كان» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause «﴿كبر عليكم مقامي﴾» is its khabar (predicate); «تذكيري» is conjoined to «﴿مقامي﴾», and «بآيات الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تذكيري﴾»; in «﴿فعلى الله﴾» the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «﴿توكلت﴾».
﴿فأجمعوا أمركم وشركاءكم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (of eloquent inference), «أجمعوا» is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and «أمركم» is a mafʿūl bihi; in «﴿وشركاءكم﴾» the wāw is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and «شركاءكم» is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative by a concealed verb, i.e. «وادعوا شركاءكم» ("and call your partners"); or it is conjoined according to the meaning; or it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), i.e. together with your partners.
﴿ثم لا يكن أمركم عليكم غمة﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction of delay (tarākhī), «لا» is prohibitive, «يكن» is an incomplete, abrogating imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), jussive (majzūm) by «﴿لا﴾», «أمركم» is the noun of «يكن», «﴿عليكم﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) and has been placed before [its noun], and «غمة» is the khabar of «يكن».
﴿ثم اقضوا إلي ولا تنظرون﴾: «ثم» is a conjunction, «اقضوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, «إليَّ» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to it; in «﴿ولا﴾» the wāw is a conjunction and «لا» is prohibitive, and «تنظرون» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لا».

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿فإن توليتم فما سألتكم من أجر﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إن» is conditional, «توليتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), «ما» is negative, «سألتكم» is a verb and its fāʿil, «من» is a connective (ṣila) particle, and «أجر» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by position.
﴿إن أجري إلا على الله﴾: «إن» is negative, «أجري» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and «على الله» is the khabar (predicate).
﴿وأمرت أن أكون من المسلمين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «أمرت» is a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and in «﴿أن أكون﴾», «أن» together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. «بأن أكون» ("to be").

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿فكذبوه فنجيناه ومن معه في الفلك وجعلناهم خلائف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «كذبوه» is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «فنجيناه» is conjoined to «كذبوه», «من» is a relative noun conjoined to the hāʾ, and the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted which is the ṣila (relative clause), i.e. «استقروا معه في السفينة» ("[who] settled with him in the ship"); «في الفلك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «نجيناه», or to the "settling" (istiqrār) which is the ṣila, i.e. "and those who settled with him in the ark"; and «﴿جعلناهم خلائف﴾» is a verb, its fāʿil and its two objects.
﴿وأغرقنا الذين كذبوا بآياتنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أغرقنا» is conjoined to «نجيناه», «نا» is the fāʿil, «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi, the clause «كذبوا بآياتنا» is the ṣila of «الذين», with no grammatical position, and «بآياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿كذبوا﴾». [Translator's note: the source calls the wāw both resumptive and conjoining «أغرقنا» to «نجيناه» — translated as written.]
﴿فانظركيف كان عاقبة المنذرين﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «انظر» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان», «عاقبة» is its noun, and «المنذرين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source heading runs «فانظر» and «كيف» together.]

muyesser-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ثم بعثنا من بعده رسلا إلى قومهم﴾: conjoined to the story of Nūḥ; «بعثنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿من بعده﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), «رسلًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلى قومهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa).
﴿فجاءوهم بالبينات فما كانوا ليؤمنوا بما كذبوا به من قبل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «جاءوهم» is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, «بالبينات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جاءوهم»; the fāʾ is a conjunction, «ما» is negative, «كانوا» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd), «يؤمنوا» is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after it, and the lām and what it governs are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «﴿بما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يؤمنوا», the clause «كذبوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «كذبوا», and «﴿من قبل﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; [«قبل»] is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning.
﴿كذلك نطبع على قلوب المعتدين﴾: in «﴿كذلك﴾» the kāf is a noun meaning «مثل» ("like"), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being «طبعًا مثلَ ذلك الطبع نطبع على قلوب المعتدين» ("with a sealing like that sealing We seal the hearts of the transgressors"); in «ذلك», «﴿ذا﴾» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; «﴿على قلوب﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿نطبع﴾», and «﴿المعتدين﴾» is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿ثم بعثنا من بعدهم موسى وهارون إلى فرعون وملئه بآياتنا﴾: «﴿من بعدهم﴾» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), «موسى» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «﴿بعثنا﴾», «هارون» is conjoined to «موسى», «إلى فرعون» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿بعثنا﴾», «ملئه» is conjoined to «فرعون», and «بآياتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «متلبسين بآياتنا» ("bearing Our signs").
﴿فاستكبروا وكانوا قومًا مجرمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «استكبروا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «﴿وكانوا﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw is its noun, «قومًا» is its khabar (predicate), and «مجرمين» is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿فلما جاءهم الحق من عندنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), the clause «﴿جاءهم﴾» being in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); or «﴿لما﴾» is linking (rābiṭa), and the clause «جاءهم» has no grammatical position; «﴿الحق﴾» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من عندنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿جاءهم﴾».
﴿قالوا إن هذا لسحر مبين﴾: the clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position; «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), «هذا» is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), «سحر» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «مبين» is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿قال موسى أتقولون للحق لما جاءكم أسحر هذا ولا يفلح الساحرون﴾: «قال موسى» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the hamza is for interrogation, «تقولون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, «للحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿تقولون﴾», «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), and the clause «﴿جاءكم﴾» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); in «﴿أسحر﴾» the hamza is for interrogation of disapproval and rebuke, «سحر» is a fronted khabar (predicate), «﴿هذا﴾» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl); in «﴿ولا﴾» the wāw is circumstantial (of ḥāl) and «لا» is negative; «يفلح الساحرون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿قالوا أجئتنا لتلفتنا عما وجدنا عليه آباءنا﴾: «﴿قالوا﴾» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), the hamza is for interrogation, and the clause «﴿أجئتنا﴾» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl); it is a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); in «لتلفتنا» the lām is of causation (taʿlīl), «تلفت» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جئتنا»; «﴿عما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿تلفتنا﴾», the clause «وجدنا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, «﴿عليه﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being «عاكفين» ("devoted"), and «آباءنا» is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتكون لكما الكبرياء في الأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿تكون﴾» is an incomplete, abrogating imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), «لكما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of «﴿تكون﴾», «الكبرياء» is its postponed noun, and «في الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. «ممتدة» ("extending").
﴿وما نحن لكما بمؤمنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «﴿ما﴾» is the Ḥijāzī negative that works like «ليس», «﴿نحن﴾» is the noun of «ما», «﴿لكما﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «﴿مؤمنين﴾», and in «﴿بمؤمنين﴾» the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition and «مؤمنين» is the khabar of «﴿ما﴾», accusative by position and genitive in form by the bāʾ.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿وقال فرعون ائتوني بكل ساحر عليم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, «قال فرعون» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), «ائتوني» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «﴿بكل﴾» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «﴿ائتوني﴾», «ساحر» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «عليم» is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿فلما جاء السحرة قال لهم موسى ألقوا ما أنتم ملقون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted, i.e. «فأتوا بالسحرة» ("so they brought the sorcerers"); the clause «﴿قال لهم موسى﴾» has no grammatical position; «ألقوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), «ما» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), «أنتم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «ملقون» is the khabar (predicate), the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the clause «ألقوا» is the speech-content (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿فلما ألقوا قال موسى ما جئتم به السحر﴾: «﴿ما﴾» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause «جئتم به» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «﴿ما﴾», with no grammatical position, and «السحر» is the khabar (predicate).
﴿إن الله سيبطله﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «سيبطله» is its khabar.
﴿إن الله لا يصلح عمل المفسدين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, the clause «لا يصلح» is its khabar, «إن» is for giving the cause (taʿlīl), and «عمل المفسدين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
